Typing blocks formation: xⁿ ∈ xⁿ needs n = n+1, so the definition is not well-formed; typed collection still constructs A¹, B², complements. Separation restricts instead: R_S ∉ S, no inconsistency — separation never promised membership in its input. Two different repairs; the account states which totality it formed and what that totality may contain.

scenes.name: Gödel incompleteness
scenes.character: Gödel incompleteness

text.title: Gödel Incompleteness — The Proof Relation Turned Inward
text.italic: Effective proof checking lets arithmetic encode its own proof relation; the fixed point obstructs completeness.
text.body: Code proofs into arithmetic: Prov_T(a) := ∃p Prf_T(p,a). The diagonal lemma gives G_T ↔ ¬Prov_T(⌜G_T⌝). If T proved G_T, the proof would have a code — contradiction; consistently, T ⊬ G_T, and G_T is true in ℕ. Rosser: two-sided unprovability from consistency alone. The derivability conditions give T ⊢ Con(T) → G_T, so T ⊬ Con(T). T+R and T+¬R both consistent; the enlargement has its own fixed point.

scenes.name: FDE and catuṣkoṭi
scenes.character: FDE and catuṣkoṭi

entities.name: SILENCE at #5 — a return, not a value

text.title: FDE, Four-Valued Logic and Catuṣkoṭi
text.italic: Two independent supports, four statuses; contradiction retained without arbitrary consequence.
text.body: Two supports, four statuses: t, f, b = both, n = neither. b∧n = f and b∨n = t — truth order, distinct from the information order (n bottom, b top). Designated D = {t,b}: p, ¬p ⊬ q — contradiction without explosion; at n, p∨¬p fails. Priest e is infectious, e ≠ n. The native crossing puts encounter first; SILENCE at #5 is a return, not a fifth value.

scenes.name: Chinese remainder, six as two by three
scenes.character: Chinese remainder, six as two by three

text.title: Chinese Remainder: Six as Two by Three
text.italic: One mod-6 address becomes two independent residues, and 3a+4b recovers it.
text.body: φ([k]₆) = ([k]₂,[k]₃) hits every pair exactly once; the inverse ψ(a,b) = 3a+4b mod 6 — (1,2) gives 11 ≡ 5. Reductions preserve + and ×: a ring isomorphism, needing gcd(2,3)=1 — with 2 and 4, (1,0) is impossible. ℤ/6 is not a field: 2·3 ≡ 0, displayed componentwise as (0,2)·(1,0) = (0,0). One address, two independent residues, lossless both ways — no QL positions assigned by algebra alone.

scenes.name: the one-element ring
scenes.character: the one-element ring

text.title: The One-Element Ring
text.italic: Ring axioms plus 0=1 force one element; a precise boundary for an algebraic interpretation.
text.body: Distributivity: a·0 = a·(0+0) = a·0 + a·0, so a·0 = 0. Assume 0=1: a = a·1 = a·0 = 0 for every a — one element, tables 0+0=0, 0·0=0. Consistent under the stated convention; it violates only added nontriviality requirements. No field element satisfies 0·b=1. The native 0/1 = 1/0 concerns orientations of one relation, not ring identities — the collapse is a boundary, not a refutation.

scenes.name: group completion and conditions of loss
scenes.character: group completion and conditions of loss

text.title: Group Completion and the Conditions of Loss
text.italic: Injectivity is equivalent to cancellation: completion loses nothing for ℕ and everything for {0,e}.
text.body: Pairs (a,b) = a−b, stabiliser t in (a,b)~(c,d) iff a+d+t = c+b+t; classes form G(M), i(a) = [(a,0)] universal. Criterion: i injective ⟺ M cancellative. ℕ completes to ℤ injectively — nothing lost. But {0, e} with e+e=e forces i(e) = 0 in any group: the completion is trivial, two elements become one. Whether an accounting suppresses distinctions depends on the field and map — not a theorem about subtraction.

scenes.name: Kauffman iterants
scenes.character: Kauffman iterants

text.title: Kauffman Iterants
text.italic: i = ση: the square is negative because the sign pattern and the shift anticommute.
text.body: An alternation read as [a,b] / [b,a]; the shift η (η²=1, [a,b]η = η[b,a]) carries phase through products. With ε = [−1,1]: i = εη, ηε = −εη, i² = −1 — neither factor alone, their composite. J = [[0,−1],[1,0]], J² = −I; aI+bJ ≅ ℂ. R(x) = −1/x orbits 1, −1, 1, …, no fixed point; the algebra enlarges to express it. Representation need not recover every process expression.

scenes.name: cross-ratio
scenes.character: cross-ratio

text.title: Cross-Ratio under Fractional-Linear Transformation
text.italic: A quantity that survives a specified transformation — and is exact about where it fails.
text.body: λ = ((z₁−z₃)(z₂−z₄))/((z₁−z₄)(z₂−z₃)), convention explicit. For f(z) = (az+b)/(cz+d), Δ = ad−bc ≠ 0, differences pick up cancelling factors: λ is invariant. (0,1,2,3) gives 4/3; z+5 keeps it; swapping two inputs gives 3/4 — order matters. Squaring the inputs gives 32/27: outside the class, distinctness survives while the invariant fails. The native (0/1)/(1/0) keeps its own seam — resemblance of nested fractions is not a map.

scenes.name: qubit and Bloch sphere
scenes.character: qubit and Bloch sphere

text.title: A Pure Qubit and the Bloch Sphere
text.italic: A formal neighbour, exactly worked: the sphere of pure states, the ball of mixtures.
text.body: Rays α|0⟩ + β|1⟩ up to phase: ℂP¹, parametrised cos(θ/2)|0⟩ + e^{iφ}sin(θ/2)|1⟩ with Bloch vector r, |r|=1 — pure states on the sphere, mixtures inside, eigenvalues (1±|r|)/2. |+⟩ and |−⟩ share probabilities 1/2, 1/2 and differ by relative phase: r = ±(1,0,0). Antipodal r are orthogonal rays; ±ψ are the same ray — two "opposites" not to be fused. A formal neighbour, not the origin of the core ontology.

scenes.name: Noether: symmetry and conservation
scenes.character: Noether: symmetry and conservation

entities.name: the drive breaks energy, not rotation

steps.text: ℓ̇ = 0 still — the charge survives the drive

text.title: Noether: Symmetry and Conservation
text.italic: Name what transforms, prove what is preserved, distinguish a change of representative from a change of law.
text.body: δℒ = E_a·δφ^a + ∂_μ(π_a^μ·δφ^a): for a constant-parameter symmetry with boundary term, j = π·Δ − B and ∂j = −E·Δ — on solutions, conserved. The oscillator: rotation gives ℓ = m(xẏ − yẋ), ℓ̇ = 0; time translation gives H, conserved when L_t = 0. With k(t): ℓ̇ = 0 still, Ḣ ≠ 0. Arbitrary-function symmetries give identities, not charges. Only observable-preserving changes are gauge candidates.

scenes.name: quaternion Q8 and rotation
scenes.character: quaternion Q8 and rotation

text.title: Quaternion Q8 and Rotation
text.italic: ij = k but ji = −k: order matters; q and −q give the same rotation.
text.body: i²=j²=k²=ijk=−1; ij=k, ji=−k — order matters. The six signed imaginary units alone are no subgroup — i·i = −1 lies outside; adjoining ±1 gives Q8. Rotation v ↦ qvq⁻¹ with q = cos(θ/2)+u·sin(θ/2) turns by θ; q and −q agree: SU(2) → SO(3) is 2:1, a continuous double cover, distinct from the Klein and torus covers. Q8 ≠ the eight determinations by cardinality.

scenes.name: calculus: local rate, constant of return
scenes.character: calculus: local rate, constant of return

entities.name: the constant is the only freedom

text.title: Calculus: Local Rate and the Constant of Return
text.italic: Differentiation retains rate and discards an additive level; the condition that selects a member is new data.
text.body: F′ = 2x has family x² + C: same slope at x=1, different values — rate kept, level dropped. Mean value: H′ = 0 on an interval forces H constant — the only freedom (one per component when disconnected). F(1) = 4 selects C = 3: new data, not contained in the derivative. The definite integral cancels the constant — a different question. ∞/dx keeps its office beside this neighbour.

scenes.name: attractors, basins, bifurcation
scenes.character: attractors, basins, bifurcation

text.title: Attractors, Basins and a Bifurcation
text.italic: x′ = μx − x³: the equilibrium structure changes at μ=0; boundary sensitivity is not chaos.
text.body: x′ = μx − x³, the negative gradient of x⁴/4 − μx²/2. μ<0: one attractor at 0. μ>0: 0 unstable, ±√μ attracting — a supercritical pitchfork at μ=0, where −x³ still attracts. For μ=1, +ε and −ε diverge to opposite basins: boundary sensitivity, not strange-attractor chaos — the destinations are simple equilibria. A trajectory is read within the changed field, not as a novel instance of an unchanged rule.

roz-matheme-ql-spanda.name: Matheme — QL and Spanda
roz-matheme-ql-spanda.description: Eight QL mathemes and the Spanda equations: the native relational derivation, its count, the crossed-zero recognition sequence, and both Spanda equations as step sequences. Source revision dbf3b17; census T25.

scenes.name: 0/1 ↔ 1/0 — the native relational derivation
scenes.character: 0/1 ↔ 1/0 — the native relational derivation

text.title: 0/1 ↔ 1/0 — The Native Relational Derivation
text.italic: The same relation read from its two ends; the defined/undefined seam stays active.
text.body: 0/1 reads the ground through its expression; 1/0 the expression towards its ground — QL writes 0/1 = 1/0 as a relational identity. Arithmetic keeps the seam: 0/1 = 0, 1/0 undefined. The outer slash holds the pair: (0/1)/(1/0). Four ordered pairings plus the retained terms give 2+2² = 4+2; the returning parent (1/0)/(0/1) carries the whole in inverse phase.

scenes.name: the two ones
scenes.character: the two ones

text.title: The Two Ones — Numerical Firstness and Relational Office
text.italic: 0 = One, 1 = All; the counted one can hold what its counting distinguishes.
text.body: The native assignment: 0 = One, 1 = All. Von Neumann floors it: 0 = ∅, 1 = {∅}, 2 = {0,1}, successor S(n) = n ∪ {n}. The singleton is not empty — its element is the empty set; the counted one holds what its counting distinguishes (Argued, not a change to cardinality). Enumeration from zero and counting from one keep different firstness conventions.

scenes.name: the slash
scenes.character: the slash

text.title: The Slash — Selection and Co-presence
text.italic: Selected difference with the field of co-presence retained.
text.body: / carries two native operations: OR makes a determinate selection; AND retains the field in which the alternatives belong. Naming the selected value does not record the field, criterion or exclusions. Applied twice to the relation: 0/1, then (0/1)/(1/0) — the outer slash acting on two complete first-order relations. Division bar, quotient and Sheffer stroke share graphics without sharing the operation.

scenes.name: six positions, eight turns — the mandala plate
scenes.character: six positions, eight turns — the mandala plate

text.title: Six Positions, Eight Turns
text.italic: Centre the 0/1 threshold; four stations N/E/W/S; the ring the #0/#5 envelope — frame, never content.
text.body: Qualitative body: #0 0/1, #1 ?/!, #2 −/+, #3 X/x, #4 AM/IS, #5 ∞/dx. Slash-form: (0/1)/(1/0), 0/0 = %, 0/1, 1/0 = ?/!, 1/1 = 100%, (1/0)/(0/1). Qualitative ?/! at #1 and processual ?/! at #3 keep different offices. Parent −/− and return 1/0 bracket the six: eight turns. Stations at the degree-table compass points; the ring the #0/#5 envelope — the mandala as the torus flat projection, 4+2.

scenes.name: 2 + 2² — binary and binary-of-binary
scenes.character: 2 + 2² — binary and binary-of-binary

text.title: 2 + 2² — Binary and Binary-of-Binary
text.italic: The two includes its act of distinction: terms and ordered relations counted without conflating types.
text.body: B×B = {(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)}: |B×B| = 4, order matters — the off-diagonal pairs keep opposed orientations. A tagged disjoint union counts terms and relations without conflating types: 2+4 = 6, the native 2+2² = 4+2. The count establishes cardinality and ordered structure; the qualitative sequence needs its own derivation. 2⁶+6²=100 is a later accountative construction, not a renaming of these six.

scenes.name: crossed zero and native re-entry
scenes.character: crossed zero and native re-entry

text.title: Crossed Zero and Native Re-entry
text.italic: 0 → Ø → X → Ø/X → (0/Ø)/(1/X) → 1 ↷ 0/1 — occlusion, mediation, field-availability, recognition.
text.body: The recognition sequence 0 → Ø → X → Ø/X → (0/Ø)/(1/X) → 1 ↷ 0/1. At Ø the slash fuses: "I am this description." At X the discrimination articulates a world. Ø/X recognises the medium as medium — no second observer behind the first. (0/Ø)/(1/X) holds subject-side and object-side recognition in one field; cancelling identical-looking symbols would erase the relations. 1 affirms the linking one; return is 0/1.

scenes.name: X/x — specification without exhaustion
scenes.character: X/x — specification without exhaustion

text.title: X/x: Specification without Exhaustion
text.italic: An actual value can be genuine without being the last value the variable can bear.
text.body: X capacity, x particular — indefinite before specification, definite in assignment. x+2=5 gives x=3 exactly; x+2=7 gives 5: no solution consumes the capacity. X/x cannot be cancelled like a quotient of scalars. The psychic unit X=x reads identity-through-difference; the agentic crosswalk is Argued — record the result with the conditions that constrained it, then let a changed context produce another result. Phenomenal subjectivity stays Open.

scenes.name: complex orientation
scenes.character: complex orientation

text.title: Complex Orientation: Measure through Rotation
text.italic: State the object, the transformation, the retained relation: point, rotation, modulus 5.
text.body: For 4+3i the coordinates are perpendicular: |z|² = 16+9 = 25, |z| = 5 — the explicate 2⁴ and implicate 3² as squared contributions of lengths 4 and 3. Quarter-turns by i preserve the modulus at every step; |e^{iφ}z|² = |z|² is a property of this transformation — scaling by 2 would double it. State the object, the transformation, the retained relation: point, rotation, modulus 5.

scenes.name: the two Spanda equations
scenes.character: the two Spanda equations

text.title: Spanda Equations and Inversion / Return
text.italic: One sixfold through two readings; the remainder completes the return.
text.body: First: 0=(0/0) → (0/1)/(1/0) → [T₀] → [T₁] → (1/0+0/1) → 1/1 = 100%; the bridge is native gathering, not a real-fraction sum. Second: 100% ⇝ 2⁶+6² = 64+36 → 64/36 → ÷4 → 16/9 = 2⁴/3² = (4/3)² → 4+2 / 4:2. Cross-comparison (4:2)/(3:3) gives (4/3, 2/3). The remainder completes the return: 2/(16/9) = 9/8; (16/9)(9/8) = 2. The comma 531441/524288 stays exact.

roz-matheme-four-files.name: Matheme — The Four Files
roz-matheme-four-files.description: Definition, process, quilt and music: the Binary Explication four-file circuit as 28 addressable matheme scenes, from "I see x" to the musical-epistemic return. Source revision dbf3b17; census T25.

scenes.name: §0/1 — the matheme
scenes.character: §0/1 — the matheme

text.title: §0/1 — The Matheme
text.italic: The sentence exposes its mediation; the signs are earned after, not before.
text.body: The sentence "I see x" performs the unit: an act of seeing, its seen, and the slash holding them. The derivation walks the acts, not a doctrine: I see x → awareness of seeing → 0/1 → −/− → 4+2 = 5→0. Diaphaneity enters as demand and method; the ground is present in every mark without becoming one more object. Each later file rereads this derivation in its own register.

scenes.name: §0 — −/− = AND/OR / X/x
scenes.character: §0 — −/− = AND/OR / X/x

text.title: §0 — −/− = AND/OR / X/x
text.italic: Two marks before their names; placement differentiates.
text.body: Stripped of assigned names, 0/1 leaves −/−: two marks of one kind, placement, and the stroke. OR selects either position; AND holds their co-presence in one relation — AND/OR names a paired relational demand, not a Boolean table. As X/x, capital capacity and lower-case instance keep identity legible through difference; parallel strokes form =, and / through it gives ≠ — identity under cut.

scenes.name: §1 — =/≠ → the expansion
scenes.character: §1 — =/≠ → the expansion

text.title: §1 — =/≠ → / = ( = =/≠ ≠ )
text.italic: Difference is identity under cut; the count is four appearances plus two operative marks.
text.body: Parallel strokes form =; the slash through them forms ≠ — difference as identity under cut. The expansion / = ( = =/≠ ≠ ) holds identity-pole, difference-pole and their exposed middle as one field. Opened analytically it counts four appearances plus the two operative marks / and =: 4+2=6 — a declared operation, not a contradiction. File 1 applies the relation to knowing as Ø/X and (0/Ø)/(1/X).

text.title: §2–§3 — 4+2 → (3+1)+2
text.italic: A counted relation remains a relation; the recount pairs terms with what holds them.
text.body: The copula counts four appearances plus two operative marks: 4+2. Held as one hinge, the middle =/≠ gives three read terms with the fourth as contextual holding: 4+2 → (3+1)+2 — a change of accounting level, not of criterion. Pairing the three terms with /, () and = gives Being, Becoming, Knowing/unKnowing — a local 3:3 whose complete articulation returns the count to the slash: the local 5→0.

scenes.name: §5 — the six determinations
scenes.character: §5 — the six determinations

text.title: §5 — The Six Determinations
text.italic: Ground becomes answerable through six determinations, bracketed by parent and return.
text.body: The qualitative body: 0/1 Ground, ?/! Definition, −/+ Dynamis, X/x Pattern, AM/IS Context, ∞/dx Realisation — each transition derived, not assigned from the count. The parent −/− precedes and 1/0 returns: eight turns, (4+2)+2, the interior body six. Harmonics pair Being, Becoming, Knowing/unKnowing; folds pair Essence 0+5, Constitution 1+4, Text–Texture 2+3. The foundation of mind remains unfound by the mental.

scenes.name: §5→0 — the catuṣkoṭi crossing

entities.name: SILENCE at #5 — not a fifth value

text.body: The catuṣkoṭi crossing: IS, IS-NOT, BOTH, NEITHER — four positions the slash holds without fusing, then SILENCE as the #5 envelope rather than a fifth answer. The crossing keeps each corner exact: negation is an operation, not a mood; the silence is the enclosing realisation, never a blank. The native seam — ordinary defined/undefined — is retained through the crossing, not used to weaken it.

scenes.name: the immutable subject
scenes.character: the immutable subject

text.title: §0/1–§5→0 — The Immutable Subject
text.italic: What can be noticed as an operation belongs to the field being known.
text.body: If a claimed cessation of the subject is known, the knowing presupposes a witness-position. Native assignments: 0 subject-position, Ø apparent subject, X object-field, 1 integrated unity, Ø/X the instrument as medium, (0/Ø)/(1/X) both recognitions in one field. What can be noticed as an operation — buddhi determines, ahaṃkāra appropriates, manas coordinates — belongs to the field being known, never to the subject-office.

scenes.name: AND + OR — the geometry of space-time
scenes.character: AND + OR — the geometry of space-time

text.title: AND + OR — The Geometry of Space-Time
text.italic: Two qualities make four composites; the count crosses the diameter.
text.body: Concatenation gives 00, 01, 10, 11; with the retained singles: 2+2² = 6. Placed N 00 · E 01 · W 10 · S 11, with 0 centre and 1 circumference, the traversal crosses the diameter — 01 → 10 turns 180°, the phase-flip inside the first pass. Endpoint identification [0,1]/(0∼1) ≅ S¹ makes return constructive; three counted advances give 3/4; three complementary pairs recover from the figure.

scenes.character: §1/0 — the phase-flip

text.title: §1/0 — 0/1 = / ≠ 1/0
text.italic: The completed figure faces its condition; reversal carries phase, and a second application restores it.
text.body: The hinge 0/1 = / ≠ 1/0 holds the two orientations as one structure in different phases. The inverse tuple carries F(5−j) at slot j′: one reversal changes order, a second restores it — F → R(F) → F. Re-entry carries phase; accumulated history needs the passage sequence. As arithmetic 0/1=0 and 1/0 is undefined; the operation uses the ordered orientation, not the evaluated fractions.

scenes.name: AND/OR — the onto-logic
scenes.character: AND/OR — the onto-logic

text.title: AND/OR — The Onto-Logic
text.italic: Four slash-forms have different mathematical conditions; neither zero-denominator form defines a quotient.
text.body: Four slash-forms, four conditions: 0/0 = % — every q solves 0q=0, indeterminate capacity; 0/1 = 0 = 0% — expression; 1/0 = ?/! — no q solves 0q=1, question held in assertion; 1/1 = 1 = 100% — achieved wholeness. Lack of solution and lack of uniqueness are distinct obstructions. Each parent (0/1)/(1/0), (1/0)/(0/1) bears the complete 4+2, the final one as 4′+2′.

text.title: §3′ — 4′+2′ = 5′→0′
text.italic: The inverse field accounts for its passage; two equations meet in standing unity.
text.body: The process-file Spanda accounting: 0=(0/0) opens into (0/1)/(1/0), passes through the two transformations T₀ and T₁, sums 1/0+0/1 and stands at 1/1 = 100%. Beside it, 3:3 — also 3:1 — and the account 100% ⇝ 64+36 → 16/9 → 4+2. The primes′ mark the inverse phase: passage as a distinct complete operation, not a rewriting of the definition-file chain.

scenes.name: ratio threshold — 16/9 = (4/3)²
scenes.character: ratio threshold — 16/9 = (4/3)²

text.title: Ratio Threshold — 16/9 = (4/3)²
text.italic: A completed account yields a proportion; the doubled fourth retains a remainder.
text.body: 16/9 = 2⁴/3² = (4/3)² — the fourth taken twice; the denominator keeps 3²=9 where 2³=8, the asymmetric flip load-bearing. Cross-comparison (4:2) with (3:3) gives (4/3, 2/3); reciprocals give the four directions. The octave stands to the doubled fourth as the fifth to the fourth: 2/(16/9) = (3/2)/(4/3) = 9/8 — and (4/3)(9/8)(4/3) = 2.

scenes.name: §4′ — harmonics and symmetries
scenes.character: §4′ — harmonics and symmetries

text.title: §4′ — 5′→0′

text.body: Adjacent pairs: Being {0,1} sum 1, Becoming {2,3} sum 5, Knowing {4,5} sum 9 — successive differences four. Folds: Essence {0,5}, Constitution {1,4}, Text-Texture {2,3}, each sum 5. The harmonics' mutual dependence is named Borromean — a field, a passage and a recognition each require the other two.

scenes.character: §5′ — the consolidated crosswalk

The traversal 1,2,3,4,5,0 carries count 1,2,3,0,4,5; the offset is exact, the count read by function.

scenes.name: §0 — the etymological ground
scenes.character: §0 — the etymological ground

text.body: The circuit VALUE → MEASURE → RATIO → EQUATION → PRODUCT → SOLVE: mattering, mark, proportion, stated equality, consequence, release. An exact allocation treated as permanently self-grounding arrests the operation at its product; SOLVE returns it so the altered situation can be measured again. Harmonics: VALUE/MEASURE Being, RATIO/EQUATION Becoming, PRODUCT/SOLVE Knowing/unKnowing. The root labels are proposals, not verified passages.

scenes.name: §1 — the Jungian architecture
scenes.character: §1 — the Jungian architecture

text.title: §1 — The Jungian Architecture
text.italic: Six views upon X=x — identity-through-difference as an operation, not two independent things.
text.body: Native X=x: X unexhausted reserve, x the capacity for specification, = the equating power. Six views of one equation: X, x, X/x, X=x, X=(x), (X=x)=X/x — not six subjects. The context move asks how a settled self-description is sustained; the parentheses of X=(x) bound the determination as permeable conditions or defended walls. Maria's axiom carries the sesquitertian 4/3 as its exact proportional carrier.

scenes.name: §2 — the Pythagorean number
scenes.character: §2 — the Pythagorean number

text.title: §2 — The Pythagorean Number
text.italic: The evolution of the equation: six exact operations, one bifurcation, one modular return.
text.body: The equation evolves: 1+1=2, 1+2=3, 1+2+3=6 (the proper divisors), 1+2+3=1×2×3=6, then 0+1+2+3=6 beside 0×1×2×3=0 — the operators carry the distinction — and 6≡0 (mod 6), a quotient operation that does not turn integer 6 into 0. The trig family gives a concrete 2+4: two initial functions, four derived. Seven convergences are an inventory of witnesses, not seven independent proofs.

scenes.character: §3 — the topological form

Six turns: Anuttara, Śiva–Śakti, Sadāśiva/Īśvara, Sadvidyā/Māyā, kañcukas+Puruṣa, Pratyabhijñā. 36=6² is exact arithmetic; the six-by-six identification of the tattvas remains Offered. Three routes converge on the epogdoon — (2/1)/(16/9), (3/2)/(4/3), (2·6²)/2⁶ = 9/8 — and (16/9)(9/8) = 2. The canonical set: 1/1, 4/3, 3/4, 3/2, 2/3, 16/9, 9/8, 2/1.

scenes.character: dia — the cut

text.title: Dia — The Cut

The carriers: (−1)+(+1)=0 cancels; (−1)−(+1)=−2 and (+1)−(−1)=+2 measure the whole span, orientation-dependent — the operator changed from retained polarity to scalar result. A zero sum forgets its summands; a difference of 2 forgets its endpoints: cancellation and appropriation, exactly demonstrable losses. A returned selection keeps input, criterion, result and the effects of exclusion.

scenes.name: syn — the gathering
scenes.character: syn — the gathering

text.body: Syn composes while source, inverse reading and affected context stay retrievable. The seam is held in (0/1)/(1/0): ordinary arithmetic computes 0/1 and leaves 1/0 undefined; treating the outer stroke as fraction division loses the operation where it matters. Terms plus their four pairings: 2+2² = 6 = 4+2 — retention, not averaging. Deleting a measurement is loss; one unsupported figure is fusion; withholding the condition is counterfeit gathering.

Histories differ: 8, 4, 2, 1, … and −4, −2, −1, … — the basin does not say which occurred. The crossing: a synchronic cut severs when the common condition is suppressed; a diachronic gathering severs when succession conceals its field. A schema is not automatically Syn; a narrative not automatically Dia.

scenes.name: projective completion
scenes.character: projective completion

text.title: Projective Completion and Changed Coordinates
text.italic: The lines do not meet in the original plane; their completed representatives meet at the named ideal point.
text.body: Homogenise: (x,y) ↦ [x:y:1]; y=2x+1 and y=2x−3 become v=2u+w and v=2u−3w, implying 4w=0 — the intersection [1:2:0], exact in ℝP², with no finite coordinate claimed and no scalar given to division by zero. Homogenisation uses an extra coordinate without raising intrinsic dimension; one-point compactification and projective completion add different boundaries. Neither statement cancels the other: their spaces differ.

scenes.name: the projective line
scenes.character: the projective line

text.title: The Projective Line
text.italic: Two charts, reciprocal transition; zero and infinity exchanged by a well-defined map.
text.body: Nonzero pairs up to scale: [x:y]. Affine chart z = x/y where y≠0 ([2:4]=[1:2]); [1:0] is the one added point, ∞ — a projective class, not 1 divided by 0. Second chart w = y/x; on the overlap w = 1/z. The swap [x:y] ↦ [y:x] is defined everywhere, exchanges 0 and ∞, extends reciprocal — a specified map, not unrestricted division. ℝP¹ is a circle; ℂP¹ the Riemann sphere.

scenes.character: the Riemann sphere

text.title: The Riemann Sphere

text.body: Ĉ = ℂ ∪ {∞} with the explicit map z ↦ (2x/(r²+1), 2y/(r²+1), (r²−1)/(r²+1)); the squared coordinates sum to 1. ∞ lands at the north pole, 0 at the south, 1 at (1,0,0); the second coordinate w = 1/z covers ∞, transition holomorphic. Reciprocal exchanges the poles without giving 0/0 a value. Sphere and torus are different constructions: simply connected against two independent generators.

scenes.character: torus, covering, winding

The loop γ(t)=[2t,−t] closes below while its lift ends at (2,−1); concatenation adds displacements: π₁(T²) ≅ ℤ×ℤ. scenes.character: the Pythagorean comma

text.title: Cycle, Interval and Octave
text.italic: Class can repeat while frequency rises: what returned and what moved, both recorded.
text.body: u = log₂(f/f₀): doubling adds 1; the class lives in ℝ/ℤ. 240, 480, 960 Hz share a class, differ in register — the quotient keeps class, forgets height. Step +2 gives two six-orbits; +7, coprime to 12, visits all twelve. Six tempered tones double the frequency; twelve tempered fifths give 2⁷ — same class, different height. A♯→C closes two semitones with a register lift, not a minor third.

scenes.name: musical resolution of arche-topos
scenes.character: musical resolution of arche-topos

text.title: Musical Resolution of Arche-Topos
text.italic: The system reaches octave return through its remainder; spatial and temporal returns coordinated.
text.body: 3:3 = 3:1 — three perspectives answered by one recognition; crossed with 4:2, inverted: 3/4 and 3/2. The chain fourth, whole-tone, fourth sounds 288 → 384 → 432 → 576 Hz; the identities sit on the plates: (3/2)/(4/3) = 9/8, (16/9)(9/8) = 2. The earned chain closes as the band carries it — 0/1 through 4+2, 5→0, 1/0, 4′+2′, 5′→0′, back to 0/1. Counted two, never the same two.

scenes.name: Metonic cycle and Antikythera
scenes.character: Metonic cycle and Antikythera

text.title: Metonic Cycle and Antikythera: Maintained Fit
text.italic: An exact count beside approximate cycles; the approximation sign is load-bearing.
text.body: 19Y ≈ 235M — the approximation is load-bearing. The count is exact under its pattern: 12×12 + 7×13 = 235. The residual δ = 235M − 19Y accumulates kδ; a machine encodes 235:19 exactly while the sky stays approximate — gearing and sky-model accuracy are separate. The Saros, 223 months, is eclipse recurrence, not the seasonal fit. Freeth 2021 proposes nine outputs; the count alone proves no gear train.

scenes.name: cymatics and standing waves
scenes.character: cymatics and standing waves

text.title: Cymatics and Standing Waves
text.italic: u = 2A·sin(kx)·cos(ωt): position and time separate; the nodes are fixed.
text.body: Superposing counter-propagating waves: u = 2A·sin(kx)·cos(ωt) — position and time separate; nodes sit fixed where sin(kx) = 0. Ends require k = nπ/L, so f_n = nc/(2L); for n=3 exactly four nodes and three antinodes — the count comes from the mode, not from any 8+4 architecture. Mode, driven response and plate pattern are three different accounts; the proposed anchor mapping is an Offered design with its test stated.

scenes.name: perfect six
scenes.character: perfect six

text.title: Perfect Six
text.italic: 1+2+3 = 6 and 1×2×3 = 6: the operators, not the numeral, carry the distinction.
text.body: Proper divisors of 6: exactly 1, 2, 3; their sum 1+2+3 = 6 — the smallest perfect number (below: 0, 1, 1, 3, 1). The same triple multiplies to 6; 28 divides otherwise. Zero enters twice: 0+1+2+3 = 6, 0×1×2×3 = 0 — the additive identity permits, the absorber dissolves. Modulo 6, 6 ≡ 0 is a quotient operation. 2+2² = 6 and 1+2+3 = 6 coincide under distinct constructions.

scenes.name: tetraktys and the 3–4–5 triangle
scenes.character: tetraktys and the 3–4–5 triangle

text.title: Tetraktys and the 3–4–5 Triangle
text.italic: Triangular ten, right-triangle six, and the two readings of 16/9 — each with its counting rule.
text.body: Rows 1, 2, 3, 4: 1+2+3+4 = 10, the sum n(n+1)/2 diagrammed. The 3–4–5 triangle: legs 4 and 3, hypotenuse 5, area 6, perimeter 12 — 16+9 = 25 counts squared lengths, not legs. Read twice: 16/9 = (4·4)/(3·3) = 2⁴/3², factor counts 4 and 6, structural content 10. The flip holds only in the numerator: 4² = 2⁴ = 16; 3² = 9 and 2³ = 8 differ.

roz-mytheme-antikythera-attunement.name: Antikythera as Attunement Instrument
roz-mytheme-antikythera-attunement.description: The whole movement of attunement: the sky exceeding the hand, gearing, coordinated cycles with their residuals, the wreck's reconstruction and its stated limit, the native archetypal return, and the instrument's return to making.

scenes.name: The sky exceeds the hand which makes it readable
scenes.character: A small material arrangement can place celestial relations before someone whose life has to proceed among them.

entities.name: the dial — small, situated, productive in its limitation
the reader — within the world being read

text.kicker: #0 · Taylor's Antikythera image; Freeth et al. 2006 (paraphrased abstract)
text.title: The sky exceeds the hand which makes it readable
text.italic: The instrument embodies attunement: exactness in the means by which a finite instrument answers to a wider field — the world continues beyond the attention.

text.body: An observer approaches a situated dial: a small material arrangement can place celestial relations before someone whose life has to proceed among them. Sun, Moon, calendar, eclipse, instrument and reader acquire relations through a work of coordination which preserves their different offices. The whole begins in this disproportion: a person cannot bring the heavens to the scale of a hand by

possessing them; craft can give the hand a determinate relation to their movements. Freeth and colleagues' 2006 abstract places the Greek device around the end of the second century BCE, with lunar phases, a luni-solar calendar and eclipse prediction among its reported functions; Antikythera is the shipwreck find-place. No ancient owner, commission or act of consultation is invented.

scenes.name: Gearing gives differentiated movement a transmissible body
scenes.character: Motion, mark and interpretation perform different work; a wheel can turn correctly while its indication is misread.

entities.name: gear train — one part moves in relation to another
the scale — makes the movement readable
the inscription — tells the reader what a mark is to be read as

text.title: Gearing gives differentiated movement a transmissible body
text.italic: The mechanism demonstrates that relations must be carried by something that can actually move, fit and indicate — without becoming the celestial event itself.

text.body: One part moves in relation to another because the material arrangement constrains their relation. A scale makes that movement readable; an inscription tells a reader what a mark is to be read as. The source of intelligibility stays distributed: gear, referent, convention, question. Remove the relation among these offices and the

completeness of one part cannot compensate — a wheel can turn correctly while its indication is misread; an inscription can remain legible when its motion is missing. The observer remains an active term: a display answers a question only through a reading, and the reader stands within the heavens the device helps disclose.

scenes.name: Coordinated cycles keep their differences
scenes.character: Calendrical recurrence and eclipse recurrence answer different questions; the Metonic and Saros operations stay distinct; attunement includes the possibility of discrepancy.

entities.name: Metonic cycle — 19 years ≈ 235 lunations; a chosen count, with residual
Saros — eclipse recurrence; a different operation
the residual — where the count does not exhaust the sky
the Metonic/Antikythera matheme owns the quantities

text.kicker: #2 · the Metonic and Antikythera matheme; A16 return
text.title: Coordinated cycles keep their differences
text.italic: A material ratio can be exact as an arrangement while its astronomical fit retains a residual — the mytheme carries the lived consequence of reckoning inside a changing world.

text.body: Several cycles become mutually readable while keeping the differences which made coordination necessary. A lunar indication, a date and an eclipse indication answer different questions even when consulted together. The matheme distinguishes the chosen calendar count from the approximate natural periods it relates, and the Metonic from the Saros operation. Attunement therefore includes the possibility of discrepancy: a

reader who recognises what an indication does and where its warrant ends can use the instrument more exactly. The obligation sharpens when the image models knowledge itself: if an answer excludes the circumstance of its obtaining, greater confidence in execution can make the exclusion harder to perceive. A16 receives the differential field coordinating heterogeneous positions.

scenes.name: The damaged instrument makes answerability unavoidable
scenes.character: From fragment toward arrangement: the 2021 nine-output proposal keeps its stated limit — lost evidence prevents claiming a replica of the original.

entities.name: nine outputs — Moon, Nodes, Mercury, Venus, Sun, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Date (2021 proposal)
the stated limit — "not a replica of the original"

text.kicker: #3 · Freeth et al. 2006 recovery; 2021 model, q001 p.2 and q002 p.12
text.title: The damaged instrument makes answerability unavoidable
text.italic: The reconstruction demonstrates rigour precisely by naming what remains unavailable — model coherence and fit support the proposal without removing the limit.

text.body: Modern investigators encounter an achieved work through surviving parts; the relation runs from fragment toward the arrangement which could have given it office. Absent parts are consequential: filling their places is reasoning whose warrant must stay distinguishable from the evidence. The 2021 study proposes a front display of nine outputs — Moon, Nodes, Mercury, Venus, Sun, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Date —

carried by nested tubes and arms; its conclusion retains the decisive limit: lost evidence prevents claiming a replica of the original. The 2006 recovery is not credited with every later feature; the model is not an intact recovered machine. The aftermath belongs to the whole image: what was made becomes a damaged inheritance; what is recovered becomes a model; the model changes the next questions.

scenes.name: The shared archetypal return — source, mark, recognition
scenes.character: The made instrument is a determinate expression whose intelligibility continues to depend on what it differentiates; the reader's return through the expression makes that dependence available again.

entities.name: Homology/Analogy — what is preserved, what stays distinct

text.kicker: #4 · Neumann whole (paper-eightfold); Taylor core theorem field; Symbolon Dynamics
text.title: The shared archetypal return — source, mark, recognition
text.italic: The refraction is Argued, not a claim that Neumann interpreted the mechanism or that its makers embodied his sequence; X/x is Taylor's, and the psychic refraction enters after the relation is established.

text.body: The Neumann whole grounds the shared source–mark–recognition relation; the source house supplies the psychic account, and Frank's protected encounter develops the mark, its field and their renewed relation. The native field gives the independent language: parent −/−; 0/1; ?/!; −/+; X/x; AM/IS; ∞/dx; returning 1/0 — not eight machine components. The local

pressure belongs to the last two movements: a dial gives an exact indication while the reader remains situated; the return preserves exactness while reopening the horizon. Symbolon Dynamics sources the image–interpreter–field recursion: an encounter with an instrument can reorganise what its reader asks of representation. The mechanism needs no psyche for that symbolic operation to live.

scenes.name: The instrument returns to making
scenes.character: Heidegger's technē/poiēsis passages and Diotima; Aristophanes' symbolon as the essay's Argued coordination; A32's threshold; Agentworld; Movement 45.

entities.name: the instrument coordinating — the mechanism continues
the reader judging — the reader continues
exposed terms — disclosure's conditions reachable by resistance

text.kicker: #5→0 · Heidegger 1977 q003; 1966 releasement; A32; Bratton q029/q038; Movement 45 (withheld until here)
text.title: The instrument returns to making
text.italic: Standing note: the Antikythera image is withheld by the essay until §5→0 · #2 — its absence earlier is an active promise; here it returns as the late, technically bounded image the argument has earned.

text.body: Heidegger's technē and poiēsis place craft within knowing and bringing-forth; his Diotima citation at Symposium 205b gives the route its text. The pairing with Aristophanes' symbolon is the essay's Argued coordination: emission makes a determinate thing available; return keeps its relation to what exceeds it active. Taylor argues retained source, disclosed measure, reversible coordination and sovereign commons give return architectural body: the instrument must expose its terms; resistance reaches them.

A32 receives its exact return — the moving mirror initiates disclosure of its conditions before asking conformity; causal influence is its necessary middle, not the completed vocation. Bratton's brief poses common grammar with divergent world-models; attunement answers with participants able to contest a source, criterion or permission. A reading can end in use, a renewed question, or setting the instrument down; fidelity survives when source and person remain beyond it.

roz-mytheme-apollo-eros-daphne-peneus.name: Apollo · Eros/Cupid · Daphne · Peneus
roz-mytheme-apollo-eros-daphne-peneus.description: The Ovidian whole: Python and the games, the boast, two contrary arrows, Daphne's granted wish, the pursuit, the transformation with its beating heart and recoil, the laurel's public office, and appropriation after withdrawal.

scenes.name: Python, the games, and the boast
scenes.character: The violent achievement joins its public commemoration before the laurel exists; the victor then disputes a boy's right to the bow.

entities.name: Python — terror spread across the mountainside
Apollo — the bow formerly used on deer and goats
Pythian games — oak leaves, no laurel yet

text.title: Python, the games, and the boast
text.italic: The opening already joins violent achievement to public memory — and the quarrel over the bow is the causal entrance to the pursuit, not an ornament.

text.body: The recovering earth produces what it had not wished to make: Python, a terror across the mountainside. Apollo kills it with a bow used before on deer and goats, and founds the Pythian games so time cannot erase the deed — victors crowned with oak, laurel not yet existing. Proud, he sees Cupid with his bow and claims the weapon's martial office; Cupid answers that his arrows can strike Apollo.
Occurrences: Python and the mountain terror (#0); the quiver nearly emptied (#0); oak crowns, laurel absent (#0); the boast and the retort (#0).

scenes.name: Two contrary arrows; Daphne's wish granted
scenes.character: The golden arrow pierces Apollo to the marrow; the leaden arrow drives love from Daphne — and before that blow the record carries her woodland life and her father's granted request.

entities.name: Daphne — wandering woods; the fillet in her hair; refusing suitors
Peneus — yields the request for perpetual virginity

text.title: Two contrary arrows; Daphne's wish granted
text.italic: The order matters: the poem narrates Cupid's blow before her woodland orientation — both facts must survive: imposed aversion, and a determinate wish her father accepted.

text.body: Cupid takes two arrows with contrary effects: one golden and pointed, exciting love; one leaden and blunt, driving it away. He strikes Daphne with the latter and pierces Apollo to the marrow with the former. Daphne's woodland life is established — suitors refused, Phoebe her model — and she asks Peneus for perpetual virginity. He yields. Reducing her to the arrow's negative charge would discard her activity and her address.
Occurrences: the two arrows and their strokes (#1); Phoebe/Diana as model and precedent (#1); Peneus' yielded permission (#1, recalled at #3).

scenes.name: The pursuit: speech fails, speed decides
scenes.character: The god who assigned Cupid the torch now burns within that office; his healing cannot cure its master; the hound and hare specify their different aims.

entities.name: Apollo — hope; breath reaching her hair
his self-listing: Delphi, Claros, Tenedos, Patara; Jupiter's son; prophecy, song, healing
the failed self-cure — another arrow has wounded him more surely
Gallic hound and hare — hunter seeks prey, hare seeks safety

text.title: The pursuit: speech fails, speed decides
text.italic: The concern changes the desired pace of the chase while leaving pursuit itself in place — competence and claimed jurisdiction come apart.

text.body: Apollo sees Daphne, desires marriage, hopes — his own prophecy misleads him. She runs; he calls that he is no enemy and proposes she run more slowly so he can pursue more slowly — the pace changes, the pursuit stays. He offers his identity, Delphi to Patara, and concedes his healing cannot cure its master. The hound seeks prey; the hare seeks safety.
Occurrences: the burning similes (#2); the imagined arranged hair (#2); the slower-pursuit proposal (#2, compared at A31); the failed self-cure (#2); breath at her hair and neck (#2).

scenes.name: The transformation — and the wood that shrank
scenes.character: Bark encloses, hair becomes foliage, feet fasten into roots; the heart still beats under the fresh bark. Miller at 1.556: "But even the wood shrank from his kisses."

entities.name: the beating heart under the fresh bark
"even the wood shrank from his kisses" (1.556)
her radiance remaining in the changed form

text.title: The transformation — and the wood that shrank
text.italic: Rescue has a cost which a general word such as "withdrawal" must continue to carry — each conversion alters a capacity the chase had used or threatened.

text.body: Her strength spent, Daphne sees Peneus's waters and calls on her father: destroy the beauty that has pleased too much. Transformation answers bodily — bark encloses her, a leaf-crown replaces her head, her radiance remaining. Apollo feels a heart beating under the fresh bark and kisses the tree; even the wood shrank from his kisses. The transformation frustrates the pursuit at the cost of her former mode of life.
Occurrences: the addressed appeal to Peneus (#1, #3); bark, foliage, branches, roots, leaf-crown (#3); the beating heart (#3); the shrinking wood (#3).

scenes.name: The laurel's public office
scenes.character: "Since Daphne cannot be his bride, she will be his tree." Laurel joins hair, lyre, quiver, triumphs, and Augustus's doorposts; the branches incline and the summit seems to nod in assent.

entities.name: the laurel — Apollo's tree: hair, lyre, quiver
Augustus's doorposts — flanking the civic oak
the seeming nod of assent — retained with the recoil, neither cancelling the other

text.title: The laurel's public office
text.italic: The tree enters the signs by which achievements and offices become publicly visible — the enduring emblem and the accomplished encounter are different things to account for.

text.body: Apollo declares what the tree will become: since Daphne cannot be his bride, she will be his tree — laurel for his hair, lyre and quiver. Laurel will accompany triumphs and the Capitol's processions and guard Augustus's doorposts. Ovid ends with the laurel inclining its branches, its summit seeming to nod in assent — following the recoil, neither moment cancelling the other.
Occurrences: the bride/tree declaration (#4); lyre, quiver, triumphs, Capitol, doorposts (#4); the nod after the recoil (#3, #4).

scenes.name: Appropriation after withdrawal
scenes.character: The image remains powerful where the hoped-for encounter failed. A20: cultural efficacy cannot by itself establish the image's fidelity to what it represents.

entities.name: the emblem travelling into public life
the tree that resisted — heart, recoil — inside the emblem's history
A27 self and other — another can appear in my world without becoming mine to complete

text.kicker: #5→0 · the ratified whole seam; A20, A27 (human-amplified: yes); C21, C27; movement 35
text.title: Appropriation after withdrawal
text.italic: The laurel figures symbolic appropriation persisting after the living source withdraws — Apollo fails to obtain Daphne as bride and establishes the changed form as his tree, emblem and public honour.

text.body: The authored interpretation: Apollo figures competent distinction become possession — his pursuit gathers measure, illumination and form around an image that begins to dictate terms to its living source. Appropriation can persist after withdrawal: the changed form becomes his tree and public honour while the telling keeps heart, recoil and seeming nod. A20 carries the seam; A27 — another can appear in my world without becoming mine to complete.
Occurrences: heart and recoil inside the public sign (#3–#5→0); the emblem's Roman future (#4, #5→0).

roz-mytheme-apollo-dionysus-daphne.name: Apollo, Dionysus and Daphne
roz-mytheme-apollo-dionysus-daphne.description: The composed philosophical whole: a world becomes a view, the view grows confident, Dionysus opens the enclosure, participation risks its own overriding image, Daphne requires someone to remain other, the view becomes transparent to its context, and form returns with its source still able to answer.

scenes.name: A world becomes a view
scenes.character: Apollo names the achievement of communicable form: a boundary makes something distinct and holdable long enough to be intelligible.

text.kicker: #0 · the authored whole; Nietzsche and Gebser in distinct registers
text.title: A world becomes a view
text.italic: Apollo embodies form's gift: the image lets one person show another what has been seen, and gives the seer something definite to revisit and change.

text.body: A finite being gives the world a form it can inhabit and communicate: something stands out, a boundary makes it distinct, an image holds it long enough to become intelligible. Apollo names this achievement — showing another what has been seen without occupying the same place, and giving the seer something definite to revisit, question and change. This is Taylor's composed whole; the sequence lives in seeing, participating and answering.
Occurrences: the standing-out and its boundary (#0); the communicable image (#0, #1); the revisitable view (#0, #5→0).

scenes.name: The view grows confident of its own completeness
scenes.character: The view conceals the life from which it was selected, then treats what escapes its measure as deficient. The absent Father gives the concealment its authorial image.

entities.name: the absent Father — surrogate authority, self-exemption
what escapes the measure — now read as deficiency
the invested viewer — body, history, language, concern

text.kicker: #1 · Gebser pp.11–21, 255–58 (paraphrased); Taylor's P5 carrier; A20
text.title: The view grows confident of its own completeness
text.italic: Possession begins when the image's valuation governs what its source is allowed to be — the aloof neutrality presents situated authority as though its conditions had vanished.

text.body: The movement begins when formation grows confident: the view conceals the life from which it was selected, then treats whatever escapes its measure as deficient. Gebser gives perspectivity its achievement — Giotto's depth, Petrarch's landscape, Alberti's construction — and its restriction when one sector claims exclusive validity. Taylor's P5 carrier brings the pressure inside the viewer: body, history,

language and concern affect what becomes salient. The absent Father gives concealment its authorial image — lack numbed, a surrogate invoked as ultimate warrant while the view's own position exempts itself from the order it imposes. A20 receives the transition: possession occurs when the image's valuation governs what its source is allowed to be; the difference appears when the source resists.

scenes.name: Dionysus opens the enclosure and returns through form
scenes.character: What dies is the form's claim to stand complete in itself; what returns must acquire a form through which living relation can continue.

entities.name: Dionysus — dismemberment and death/rebirth of bounded identity
Nietzsche §21 — each power expressive through the other

text.kicker: #2 · Nietzsche Birth of Tragedy §1 (p.21) and §21 (p.167); the central plan's dismemberment
text.title: Dionysus opens the enclosure and returns through form
text.italic: Dionysus names the release through which the view's implication in life becomes available again — within this composition, what dies is the form's claim, and what returns must be communicable enough to answer for.

text.body: Participation restores the view to the living relation its self-sufficiency concealed. The central plan gives this release the force of dismemberment and death/rebirth: within this Taylor-authored sequence, what dies is the form's claim to stand complete in itself; what returns must acquire a form through which living relation can continue. Nietzsche supplies the artistic relation: in §1, art develops through the duplexity of the Apollonian

and Dionysian; in §21, Dionysus speaks Apollo's language and Apollo finally speaks Dionysus's. The formed account must let its participation affect what it says; participation must become communicable enough for a particular speaker to answer for it. Yet openness does not settle the question: participation can itself become an overriding image — unity deciding in advance what another being's difference must mean.

scenes.name: Daphne requires someone to remain other
scenes.character: Apollo cannot make illumination into entitlement; Dionysus cannot make participation into permission to absorb. Her alterity requires both powers to return differently.

entities.name: Daphne — the centre that exceeds what either power makes of her
the transformed tree's recoil — preserved with the seeming assent
Dionysus — openness without dissolving the responder

text.kicker: #3 · the alterity check (human-amplified: yes); the Ovidian whole kept distinct
text.title: Daphne requires someone to remain other
text.italic: Daphne proves-discloses the difference between failures: appropriation through determination and appropriation through undifferentiation — her separate literary whole bears its own cast, pursuit, transformation and afterlife.

text.body: Daphne changes what the mutuality must accomplish: a relation can be vivid and shared while still failing to let the other answer in their own right. Apollo cannot make illumination into entitlement; Dionysus cannot make participation permission to absorb. Her office is the particular centre whose existence exceeds what either power makes of it.

Her separate literary whole is Ovid's; the movement-35 return keeps the tree's recoil with the narrator's seeming assent, so no easy union or final refusal replaces it. Appropriation after withdrawal: possession failing at one level need not end the image's symbolic continuation. Unity invoked to cancel refusal repeats appropriation by other means. Occurrences: her required otherness (#3); recoil with seeming assent (Mv 35); Dionysus enters through Taylor, not Ovid.

scenes.name: The view becomes transparent to its context
scenes.character: The 180°→360° operation: positions, counter-positions and the conditions of their transition become available together; the knower has a position within that field.

entities.name: the viewer within the field — fourth-person
Gebser's aperspectivity — no amalgamation of structures
care and telos — being with text and subtext

text.title: The view becomes transparent to its context
text.italic: The diaphanous form embodies determination visible together with the conditions through which it became a view — promising no exhaustive panorama.

text.body: The resulting form is diaphanous: its determination remains visible together with the conditions through which it has become a view. Gebser's aperspectivity releases perspective from exclusive validity without amalgamating earlier structures; his Picasso/Braque discussion makes time and multiple aspects material to representation. Q27's contextual-field programme gives the movement its 180°→360° expression: the perspectival triangle opens

into a field where positions, counter-positions and transitions are available together — and the knower has a position within that field. Wider collections cannot accomplish this by accumulation; limits, relations and means of transformation have to become intelligible. P5's concern gives transparency a lived direction: equanimity requires acknowledging concern; the pose of having no stake can conceal a governing preference.

scenes.name: Form returns with its source still able to answer
scenes.character: Apollo returns to articulation; Dionysus remains effective within its communicability; Daphne remains effective within that participation.

entities.name: the finite act of seeing — renewed
the other's answer — remaining their own
A20 — the source's continuing capacity to revise the image
A21 — individuation retains the mediating relation
Draft 3 — recognition recurrent, never completed possession
the definite image offered again — Apollo's articulation returned, bearing its acknowledged relation

text.kicker: #5→0 · A20/A21; Movement 35; Draft 3; the shared Neumann ground
text.title: Form returns with its source still able to answer
text.italic: What returns is a form capable of being changed by the world it discloses — the sequence closes in another finite act of seeing, where the other's answer remains their own.

text.body: The shared Neumann whole grounds the declared A20/A21 relation through differentiation, the image's power and transformed recognition; the composed whole gives that structuration its form–participation–alterity movement. Apollo returns to articulation — a definite image again offered, now bearing an acknowledged relation to the life it expresses and the difference it cannot appropriate. Dionysus remains effective within its communicability; Daphne remains

effective within that participation — another centre can answer without being pre-assigned the answer completing the speaker's image. Draft 3: truth beyond any frame, truth through this particular angle and life; a form once opened can close again, and renewed encounter must affect its valuation. Declared cross-story: Daphne ↔ the Apollo/Dionysus bracket — distinct casts. Occurrences: renewed finite seeing (#0, #5→0); the answer remaining the other's own (#3, #5→0).

roz-mytheme-ares-aphrodite-hephaestus-po.name: Ares, Aphrodite, Harmonia, Eros, Hephaestus and Poseidon — the whole relation
roz-mytheme-ares-aphrodite-hephaestus-po.description: Demodocus' song in whole sequence: the bed, the bonds, the distinct genealogies, generative difference, the capture apparatus stalled at its own limit, Poseidon's surety, and the relation after release.

scenes.name: The song, the bed, and the gods at the door
scenes.character: Demodocus takes the lyre among the Phaeacians; the tale turns to Ares and Aphrodite in Hephaestus's house.

text.title: The song, the bed, and the gods at the door
text.italic: The song demonstrates an exposure, a dispute, an undertaking and a release — payment is not narrated; no repaired marriage ends it.

text.body: Demodocus takes up his lyre among the Phaeacians; Odysseus has watched the dancers' feet. The song turns to Ares and Aphrodite, who met secretly in the house of Hephaestus. Helios saw the lovers and carried the news to the husband — and watched again, later, when the unseen work had closed.
Occurrences: Demodocus' lyre and the dancers' circle (#0 opening); Helios' first seeing and report (#0); the secret meeting in Hephaestus' house (#0).

scenes.name: Bonds beyond the gods' sight
scenes.character: Hephaestus forges bonds no one can break or loosen, arranges them around the bed, and pretends to leave for Lemnos.

text.title: δεσμοὶ τεχνήεντες — bonds as fine as a spider's web
text.italic: The craft demonstrates what technique can enclose: the bonds are beyond even the gods' sight, and the same hands will later undo them.

text.body: In pain and anger Hephaestus sets his anvil and makes bonds that can neither be broken nor loosened — around the bedposts, suspended from the beams, fine as a spider's web, beyond the gods' sight. He pretends to leave for Lemnos. Ares sees the husband gone, takes Aphrodite's hand, and the unseen work closes; only then do they know escape is impossible.

Occurrences: anvil and forge (#0); bedposts, beams, spider's-web bonds (#0); feigned departure to the Sintians of Lemnos (#0); Ares' own watch supplying the trap's occasion (#0, #3); Helios' second report (#0).

text.title: Claim, witness, verdict
text.italic: The sequence demonstrates adjudication with its parts held apart: the divine arbiters are distinct from the king's witnessing, and the testimony to the planting is the award's stated ground.

text.body: Cecrops, son of the soil compounded of man and serpent, has already named the country Cecropia. Poseidon arrives first and strikes the middle of the Acropolis with his trident, producing the sea called Erechtheis. Athena arrives, calls Cecrops to witness her taking possession, and plants an olive. Zeus separates them and appoints the twelve gods; the country is awarded to Athena on Cecrops's testimony, and she names the city Athens.

text.title: Presence becomes addressable through a form

text.body: Presence becomes addressable through a form. A face turns towards someone; a name lets that person be called again; a role gives an undertaking a recognisable place. Someone can now be met, remembered, trusted, opposed or answered. A person does not first become complete in isolation and then add a public mask — language, expression and shared practices participate in the life that appears.

Yet no achieved presentation finishes that life: the named can answer differently; the one approached through a role can question what the role permits. Descent names the movement into a form that can act — a voice rather than every possible voice, an entrusted representative rather than an undertaking with no bearer. text.body: The idol closes the path through the image: the bearer remains visible while losing the ability to change the terms of representation; contrary speech is classified as further evidence. Ovid: Daphne's refusal and Peneus's grant precede the pursuit; the changed body feels, recoils from the kiss, is claimed for Apollo's emblems — seeming assent retained, neither detail authorising consent. Job tests another image: an account of justice defended by making Job the guilty person it needs; the whirlwind changes the field, the friends are rebuked, restoration passes through his intercession. text.title: Worship displaced; the bridal exposure; Zephyr
text.italic: The telling demonstrates an elevation that makes its object publicly desirable and privately unreachable — Psyche tells her parents their lament comes late.

text.body: Psyche's beauty brings worship before it brings a lover: visitors abandon Venus's shrines for a mortal woman, and Psyche, admired beyond ordinary courtship, remains alone. Venus receives the displaced worship as affront and orders her winged son to make Psyche fall in love with a man degraded by poverty and misfortune. The father consults

Apollo's Milesian oracle: her husband will be a winged, serpentine terror; the wedding procession takes the form of a funeral. Psyche tells her parents they should have mourned when the people's worship raised her against Venus. She goes to the appointed height — and Zephyr receives the exposed girl and carries her gently down to a grassy valley.

text.title: The palace of invisible service
text.italic: Psyche is received into pleasure and cut off from human company — the enforced concealment already constrains the relation before the sisters speak.

text.body: The palace in the valley seems built by divine hands: precious floors give their own light, riches lie unguarded, voices welcome and serve though no servant is seen. At night a husband comes to her bed, his face unseen; fear gives way to union. He warns that her sisters will come and that responding brings danger; her grief moves him to permit a visit — the prohibition remains.

The sisters arrive, measure her fortune against their own marriages, conceal her good fortune and plan her ruin. He warns again: the child will be divine if she keeps the secret, mortal if she betrays it. Her incompatible accounts — young hunter, greying merchant — let them infer a divine husband; they supply the serpent story and prescribe a sharpened blade and a covered lamp.

text.title: The lamp: truth seen, wound dealt
text.italic: The lamp episode gives the formal limit bodily precision: a determination (blade, false account, enforced concealment) cannot exhaust the responsive life it determines.

text.body: Psyche takes both instruments to the bed, fearing the supposed beast and loving the husband she has known. When the lamp opens the darkness she sees Cupid; the blade loses its object and for a moment threatens her before falling from her hand. She pricks her thumb on an arrow point and falls more deeply in love with Love.

A drop of oil falls on his right shoulder — the narrator gives the lamp a desire; he wakes and flies; she clings until she falls. From a cypress: he disobeyed Venus, wounded himself with his own arrow, made Psyche his wife — and names the sisters' punishment. Pan with Echo counsels appeal, not death. Her next act brings the sisters to the rock, neither caught — no moral ascent.

text.title: The four labours — help distributed across the world
text.italic: The labours demonstrate dependencies of achievement: Psyche listens, waits, carries and refuses; the relationship returns through capacities and responses not her own.

text.body: Psyche first seeks shelter: Ceres and Juno see her distress yet refuse protection through their allegiance to Venus. She surrenders to Venus herself; Consuetudo seizes her hair; Anxiety and Sorrow torture her. Task one: a heap of wheat, barley, millet, poppy, chickpeas, lentils and beans sorted by nightfall — an ant takes pity and summons its fellows; Venus refuses her the credit. Task two: wool from fierce

golden-fleeced sheep; a reed speaks — wait for the declining sun and river breeze, gather what they have left on the branches. Task three: water from the terrible height feeding Styx and Cocytus; she stands motionless before the dragons until Jupiter's eagle, remembering Cupid's help, takes the vessel and announces Venus's commission. The completed tasks bring further demands; under the same roof, access to Cupid stays denied.
Occurrences: the refused shelters (#3); the seed heap and ants (#3); the reed's timing (#3); the eagle and the crystal vessel (#3); the refused credits (#3).

text.title: The descent, the box, and the waking
text.italic: The fourth labour contains a descent and return inside itself: the tale's movements nest rather than supplying six mutually exclusive episodes — and the waking is an arrow-prick after the removal of sleep, no kiss performs it.

text.body: Venus sends Psyche to Proserpina for beauty, claiming hers spent on Cupid. Psyche reads death and climbs a tower to jump — but the tower addresses her: death would take her below without the means of return. The route: two cakes, two coins; the driver refused; Charon's fee taken by his own hand; the floating dead left; the weavers refused — each appeal a trap. One cake quiets the dog.

She declines the seat and rich food, receives the closed box, pays the dog and Charon with the reserved second portions — the reserves made the round trip. She opens the box for beauty: infernal sleep pours out and leaves her like a corpse. Cupid, healed, wipes the sleep back into the box and wakes her with a harmless prick of his arrow — the rebuke: curiosity endangering her again.
Occurrences: the tower's route and refusals (#4); the cakes and coins as reserves for return (#4); the opened box (#4); the arrow-prick waking (#4, against modern-kiss substitutions).

text.title: Fruit, valley, river
text.italic: The stanza demonstrates different temporal movements held together — arriving, receiving and passing — before the one who notices change becomes its subject.

text.body: The second stanza answers the wish to hold with an instruction: take your share. Whoever wants the fruit must reach promptly — ripening and germination overlap; what passes includes both loss and advent. roz-mytheme-indra-net.name: Indra's jewel net — the whole within each reflection
roz-mytheme-indra-net.description: The Huayan contemplation in sequence: the chosen jewel, recursive entry without leaving, the ink-dot test, the simile's self-limitation, answerability of use, and return to the southwest jewel.

scenes.name: A jewel is chosen within the net
scenes.character: The contemplating eye meets a field in which phenomena enter one another; the choice gives attention an exact place to begin.

text.kicker: #0 · Dushun-attributed contemplation; Cleary 2000 excerpt; T45 no. 1867, 513a20–513c16
text.title: A jewel is chosen within the net
text.italic: The image demonstrates knowing placed within relation: the eye cannot secure an independent beginning outside the field and look down upon the result.

text.body: If phenomena arise through conditions, how can they be known? The answer places knowing within their relation. The jewels are clear; in every jewel the others appear, and what appears includes their reflections of one another. Choose a jewel in the southwest: all the other jewels are reflected there together, and each of those also reflects the whole,

including the selected jewel. Nothing reserves this for the southwest — begin elsewhere and it holds; every jewel supplies a particular entrance, none has to travel to a privileged centre. The claim works through simultaneous manifestation and the absence of coming and going; its sequence must not become signals taking successive journeys.
Occurrences: the net and its jewels (#0); the southwest selection (#0); reflections including reflections (#0, #1); Indra's naming (#1).

scenes.name: Entering the others without leaving this one
scenes.character: Remaining here is the condition of entry; the movement reverses without losing its starting place.

the others present within this one
the net reopened inside its own appearance

text.kicker: #1 · the questions and the answering voice
text.title: Entering the others without leaving this one
text.italic: The contemplation demonstrates that leaving the jewel would abandon the very relation through which the others are disclosed.

text.body: To enter all the jewels from here is to discover their presence in this one; in those jewels this one is present again. Reflections contain reflections which contain the first reflection, with no final image at which the relation is exhausted. The interlocutor presses: how can one enter all while remaining here?

The reply makes remaining here the condition of entry. And if the many are present within this one, why a net of many jewels? Because the one in its comprehensive aspect includes the many — remove that constitutive participation and the net is not preserved. Each apparent opposition returns to how each is present through the others.
Occurrences: remaining-in-entry (#1); the two questions and replies (#1); the one's comprehensive aspect (#1).

text.italic: The mark proves-discloses an inspectable return: a local act appears throughout the reflection without a messenger touring the net.

The mark makes a return inspectable: something done at this definite place becomes present through the others, and the others disclose this place in turn. The expanded sequence is recoverable in the Chinese text, T45 no. 1867, 513a20–513c16; the account is a prose paraphrase, not a newly certified quotation from Cleary's printed edition.

closing verses — Vairocana's activity for beings

text.kicker: #2 · the simile's qualification; Van Norden–Jones §1.3 and §3; C24 fusion
text.title: The image teaches where its own likeness ends
text.italic: The teaching demonstrates its own limit immediately after its most forceful demonstration — the optical apparatus is not a complete account of the reality contemplated.

text.body: The teaching does not end with the dot; it turns upon its simile. Jewels have images which enter one another while their material substances remain separate; the phenomena contemplated interpenetrate more completely. The restriction belongs to the source's own movement, preventing the observer from taking the optics as the whole account. The closing verses direct the teaching toward Vairocana's activity for beings: formless reality

manifests forms. Van Norden–Jones qualify the reading: dependence for existence and identity (§1.3), and Zhiyan's Ten Mysteries preserving distinction within mutual inclusion (§3). C24 (fusion) qualifies the essay's comparison at this precise point — an account of inclusion fails when it erases the differences through which relation can occur.
Occurrences: the simile qualification (#2); the closing verses (#2); the separate jewel substances (#2); the Ten Mysteries' preserved distinction (#2).

scenes.name: The definite jewel carries its constituting field
scenes.character: A11/C49 two Ones; A12 Mono/Poly; the apoha braid; A18 eightfold; Dia/Syn — the image lets the movement be followed without manufacturing eight ancient jewels.

entities.name: the braid: apoha · dependent arising · saṃkalpa

text.title: The definite jewel carries its constituting field
text.italic: The chosen jewel figures a determination through which an already active relation becomes locally available — the image lets the eightfold be followed without assigning each determination a jewel.

text.body: The native core grounds the QL relation before its refraction here: 0 = One, Self-Identity; 1 = All, Self-Difference. A12 grounds the whole-first consequence: the whole contains real particulars (inclusive aspect) and is their constituting relation (generative aspect). The braid has three distinguishable tasks — A08/C18 apoha qualifies determination through constitutive exclusion; dependent arising names conditioned occurrence; saṃkalpa's world-building office joins them; the net supplies

recursive mutual inclusion without teaching all three as one doctrine. A05/C13 qualify the reflective crossing: an inert reflected picture does not perform self-apprehension — the jewel cannot establish consciousness by being reflective. A18's eight determinations are followed without manufacturing eight jewels; the reader's traversed relation is the mythemic work. Native 2+2²=6 retains two terms and their four ordered pairings — not a count discovered in the treatise.

text.kicker: #4 · Symbol/Account/Trust field; A20; C38; A26; A23; A27; A30/C42
text.title: A reflection becomes answerable for its use
text.italic: The whole demonstrates the four operations: disclosure, answerable account, committed reliance, and consequences that change the next account.

text.body: Symbol answers to source: this net conducts a source-specific relation, including the passage's qualification of its own simile; A20 receives the consequence that an impressive image must remain alterable by what it represents. Account does not replace source: C38's Bimba–Pratibimba gives a locally agreed reference real local authority answerable beyond that office; A26 receives the worldhood distinction without turning Huayan into

database architecture. Trust keeps the return route active: the jewel's clarity supplies no promise that another person will answer (A23, A27). Account re-enters source-field: the ink dot is a precise source image of a local mark appearing throughout reflection; the essay's further operation concerns conduct changing the conditions of future description (A30/C42) — a reflected mark is not evidence such institutional revisions occurred.

Declared cross-story: the Ares–Aphrodite–Hephaestus–Poseidon whole — the double-net comparison distinguishes mutual implication from capture organised as public evidence; Homer's bonds keep their actors, this net keeps its jewels; the relation is the essay's Offered comparison. ↳ Occurrences: the simile qualification answering to source (#2, #4); the ink dot (#1, #4).
