No particular earthlight event is verified here. Human-amplified: yes for the admitted discharge/confinement comparison. This whole returns-to A17 and A18 with reserve/extension intact.

scenes.name: The Neumann ground and its variants
scenes.character: World parents, Prajāpati, En-Soph, the self-rolling wheel, Aion and Gebser — substantial differences in what the images do, not interchangeable costumes for the snake.

entities.name: mother and child — nourishment through differentiated dependency
world parents — day at #5, night at #0, four directions at #1–#4 (p.108)
Jung's Self/shadow horizon; Gebser's changed seeing

text.kicker: #4 · Neumann source house; Frank's protected encounter pp.11–35, 104–121; Jung Aion; Gebser
text.title: The Neumann ground and its variants
text.italic: The shared ground qualifies the native operation without delimiting it: extracting only a perfect circle would lose the bodily and developmental middle that gives the round life.

text.body: Neumann's round is encountered within a sustained account of formation: pp.12–18 open womb, parents, mark and page, and the self-rolling wheel; pp.27–35 give appetite, digestive passage and centroversion; pp.104–121 carry the world parents — separation, light, orientation, guilt. Prajāpati's self-creation and the horse/universe image arrive through Neumann's mediation of Deussen, a nested encounter, not a newly verified Vedic telling. En-Soph

(p.18) and tohubohu (p.106) belong to different inherited traditions read at the indistinct pole without historical identity. The mark-paper-erasure scene compares a second performable return. Jung's Aion sources the Self/shadow horizon; Gebser historicises perspective's release from exclusive claim — neither derives the torus. The paśu correction holds: in the p.105 Ātman passage, I-am recognition precedes the separation into husband and wife.

scenes.name: The snake returns with its hole intact
scenes.character: Hunger still moves, but a received thing can change the terms of receiving. The Māyā-not-the-hole distinction stands; the eightfold recapitulation is complete.

entities.name: the round — wholeness keeping its opening
the intact hole — constitutive, not absent
C21 living symbol / idol — the image's efficacy stays in relation to what it cannot exhaust
rest — the next circuit need not be demanded

text.kicker: #5→0 · C21; Arbitration/Hybris/Regard/Anamnesis field; A26; A17; Draft 3; A36; Homologia/Analogia
text.title: The snake returns with its hole intact
text.italic: Recognition restores the relation within the differentiated body: the head remains head, the tail remains tail, and what the passage has changed remains changed — Māyā is the measure, never the hole; the paśu correction holds the ontological order.

text.body: What seemed an absence becomes intelligible as constitutive of the form. C21: the image's efficacy remains in relation to what it cannot exhaust; it becomes an idol when its success prohibits the relation from changing it. The Arbitration field grounds the consequence: hybris flowers when the local measure claims source authority; regard and anamnesis permit return. A17 qualifies circulation: a completed act can return into another performance, and come

to rest — making wholeness depend on perpetual production would restore the consuming hunger at the point of release. Draft 3 sources the terminal consequence: the completed offering is released into lives whose future it cannot command. The eight determinations remain active through the image — eight turns of one relation, not eight phases of a snake. Human-amplified: yes for the eightfold recapitulation and the Māyā-not-the-hole distinction.

roz-mytheme-valentinian-sophia-horos-ach.name: Valentinian Sophia, Horos, Achamoth and Soter
roz-mytheme-valentinian-sophia-horos-ach.description: The reported whole in sequence: the Ogdoad's conjunctions, Sophia's solitary reach and Horos's restoring limit, the collective Soter, Achamoth's two formations, the Demiurge who does not know his mother, and the bridal return with what remains outside.

scenes.name: The fullness in conjunction
scenes.character: Bythus and Sige; Nous and Aletheia; Logos and Zoe; Anthropos and Ecclesia — thirty Aeons in fifteen syzygies, with a shared longing none of them fully knows.

entities.name: the Ogdoad — the four primary conjunctions
the Decad and Duodecad — two branches of further generation
Sophia — youngest of the Duodecad, joined to Theletos
Nous alone comprehends the Father; the rest long and are restrained

text.kicker: #0 · Irenaeus, Against Heresies I.1.1–I.2.1 (Roberts–Rambaut; hostile testimony, named as such)
text.title: The fullness in conjunction
text.italic: The opening demonstrates a world articulated through conjunction: generation gives the fullness order and plurality without distributing the Father's knowledge equally.

text.body: At the beginning stands Bythus, the Depth, with Ennoea/Charis/Sige. After stillness he deposits the intended emanation in Sige; she conceives Nous together with Aletheia. These four constitute the first Tetrad; Nous and Aletheia produce Logos and Zoe; Logos and Zoe produce Anthropos and Ecclesia — the primary Ogdoad. Two branches follow: a Decad from Logos and Zoe, a Duodecad from Anthropos and Ecclesia:

thirty Aeons in fifteen conjunctions, their names attached to their positions, some repeated across levels without identity. Nous alone comprehends the Father; he wishes to communicate the greatness, but Sige restrains him by the Father's will. The desire to behold the producer of its seed precedes Sophia's crisis: the youngest of the Duodecad presses that desire beyond the measure sustained by her conjunction. Irenaeus's accusations and rebuttals remain distinct voices.
Occurrences: the fifteen syzygies (#0); the repeated names kept distinct (#0, #2); the shared longing (#0, breaking out at #1).

scenes.name: Sophia reaches; Horos restores
scenes.character: She strains into the Father's depth and nears dissolution; Horos supports and restrains; purified, she returns to conjunction — while her enthymesis, carrying its passion, is excluded.

entities.name: Sophia's solitary reach — apart from Theletos, nearing dissolution in the Father's sweetness
Horos / Stauros — the same power establishing and dividing
the enthymesis — the intention excluded with its passion; later called Achamoth
the amorphous-birth variant — a second articulation, not silently merged

text.title: Sophia reaches; Horos restores
text.italic: The limit demonstrates its double function: it protects a differentiated fullness, and the life placed outside persists — restoration and expulsion are two consequences of one separating act.

text.body: Sophia seeks the Father apart from Theletos. Passion is a reaching towards what exceeds her capacity: she strains into his depth, near dissolution in his sweetness. Horos supports and restrains; she returns to herself, recognises the Father incomprehensible and relinquishes the intention — survival depends on a limit sustaining what it bounds. A reported variant: an amorphous substance brought forth without her consort, grieving and fearing — two articulations, distinguishable.

The Father produces Horos through Monogenes, in the Father's image; named also Stauros and Metagoges, he separates Sophia's enthymesis from Sophia herself. She, purified, remains and returns to her conjunction; her enthymesis is excluded — later called Achamoth, and the naming must not send the restored upper Sophia into exile a second time. At I.3.5 Stauros names the sustaining function and Horos the separating: the same power establishes and divides.

Occurrences: the solitary reach and near-dissolution (#1, #5→0's founding comparison); Horos's two functions (#1); the excluded enthymesis (#1, becoming #3's Achamoth); the variant kept distinct (#1).

scenes.name: Teaching, thanksgiving, and the common fruit
scenes.character: Christ teaches the conjunctions and the Father's incomprehensibility; the Aeons rest, give thanks, and each contributes what is most beautiful — together producing the Soter.

entities.name: the earlier Christ — produced by Monogenes and Aletheia; teacher of the Aeons
the Holy Spirit — bringing thanksgiving and rest
the contributions — each Aeon's most beautiful, composing one common fruit
the Soter — Jesus, Saviour, called also Christ, Logos and Everything because he comes from all

text.title: Teaching, thanksgiving, and the common fruit
text.italic: The sequence demonstrates the fullness's answer: what Sophia attempted through solitary extension becomes something the fullness learns together — and produces together.

text.body: The Pleroma responds to Sophia's crisis with a new conjunction: by providence Monogenes produces Christ and the Holy Spirit so the Aeons will not suffer a similar passion. Christ teaches the nature of their conjunctions and the Father's incomprehensibility: what Sophia tried to overcome through solitary extension becomes something the fullness learns together. The Holy Spirit brings the Aeons to thanksgiving and rest; their forms become equal; they cease private

striving and share joy. From that common state each contributes what is most beautiful and excellent in itself; Christ and the Spirit concur, and the contributions compose Jesus, the Saviour — also called Christ, Logos and Everything because he comes from all. The earlier Christ and the collective Soter stay distinct: the first teaches and will give Achamoth initial form; the Soter, the common fruit, will complete another formation.
Occurrences: the teaching and rest (#2); the contributed beauty composing the Soter (#2, #5→0's bridal return); the two named Christs distinguished (#2, #3–#4).

scenes.name: Achamoth receives form twice
scenes.character: Formed according to substance, then according to intelligence; tears, smile and grief become substrates; conversion generates the psychic; the angels' likeness the spiritual seed.

entities.name: Achamoth in darkness and vacuity — formless, like an untimely birth
the first formation — according to substance; the odour of immortality left behind
the affects becoming cosmos — tears→liquid, smile→lucid, grief/perplexity→corporeal; the second account: fear→psychic, grief→wicked spirits
the second formation — the Soter strengthening her; passions separated into substrates; spiritual seed conceived in the angels' likeness
Horos stops her crossing back — her cry of Iao

text.kicker: #3 · I.4.1–I.4.5; the translation's tension retained, neither wording rewritten
text.title: Achamoth receives form twice
text.italic: The double formation demonstrates the passage from exclusion to the conditions of a world: sorrow does not exhaust her condition, because the memory of light can still make her smile.

text.body: Outside the Pleroma the expelled enthymesis exists in darkness and vacuity, without form: this is Achamoth, the lower Sophia. The earlier Christ gives her form according to substance, then withdraws, leaving an odour of immortality. Horos stops her crossing back; her cry of Iao enters as that name's explanation. Desire, grief, fear and perplexity follow; she turns to the one who gave her life. A translation tension is retained.

first account tears give liquid substance, the remembered light's smile gives the lucid, grief and perplexity yield corporeal existence; her conversion generates the psychic order including the Demiurge. Achamoth petitions the withdrawn Christ; he sends the Paraclete with angels. She receives strength before his splendour and meets his coming: he forms her by intelligence and heals her passions into substrates — passion→material, conversion→psychic.
Occurrences: the two formations (#3); the two affect-to-cosmos accounts (#3, #4's second table); the spiritual seed (#3, returning at #5→0); the retained translation tension (#3).

scenes.name: A maker who does not know his mother
scenes.character: Achamoth forms the psychic Demiurge; through her, hidden, he makes the images of higher realities, seven heavens and the elements; his declaration "no other God" expresses his ignorance of what exceeds him.

entities.name: Achamoth — moving him without making herself known
the Demiurge — ordering the substances, ruling the Hebdomas
the seven heavens; Achamoth's Ogdoad dwelling above him, below the Pleroma
the second affect table — earth: stupor, water: fear, air: grief, fire inherent in the three
the human — earth, psychic breath, skins; the spiritual seed placed within the Demiurge unknowingly

text.kicker: #4 · I.5.1–I.5.6; I.6's reported distinctions under Irenaeus's polemic; I.7.2's "some"
text.title: A maker who does not know his mother
text.italic: The Demiurge demonstrates effective but derivative agency: his ordering power is real within its world while he cannot give an account of its source — and disclosure later changes his self-understanding without abolishing his work.

text.body: Three kinds now stand: material from passion, psychic from conversion, spiritual offspring. Under the Soter's instruction she forms the psychic Demiurge; through him she images higher realities — her agency hidden from the maker she produces. He orders the substances, fashions seven heavens and becomes their ruler, the Hebdomas. Achamoth's dwelling lies above him, below the Pleroma — an intermediate Ogdoad. He imagines he has made everything

through his own agency; his "no other God" declares his ignorance of what exceeds him. The second affect table: fear→psychic beings, grief→wicked spirits and the Cosmocrator; earth from stupor, water from fear's movement, air from grief. The Demiurge forms a human, breathes the psychic principle, clothes it with skins; Achamoth places spiritual seed within him. The "some" of I.7.2 keep a fourfold Christology (marked variant).

Occurrences: the hidden maternal agency (#4, returned at #5→0's education); the seven heavens and intermediate Ogdoad (#4); the two affect accounts (#3, #4); the seed placed unknowingly (#4, maturing at #5→0).

scenes.name: Bridal return and what remains outside
scenes.character: Achamoth enters the Pleroma as bride; the spiritual become brides of the angels; the Demiurge restored to the intermediate place; fire consumes matter and itself. The founding comparison stays Offered.

entities.name: the bridal chamber — Achamoth joined to the Soter; the spiritual to the angels
the Demiurge's reward — the intermediate dwelling; righteous psychic souls resting, not entering
fire consuming matter and finally itself
the founding comparison — Offered; human-amplified: no: Sophia's reach, Horos's limit, the common fruit beside 0/1→4+2

text.kicker: #5→0 · I.7.1, I.7.5; the variants of I.11–I.12, I.15, I.17, I.21; A13 and A19 as Offered returns
text.title: Bridal return and what remains outside
text.italic: The ending changes how the boundary is understood: Horos's exclusion did not make the lower passion inert — beyond the limit Achamoth received form, generated seed and mediated a cosmos; the restoration does not carry every product to one destination.

text.body: Consummation waits on the seed's formation. At perfection Achamoth enters the Pleroma, joining the Soter as bride to bridegroom; the spiritual people become brides of the accompanying angels — the angel-sighted generation reaching union. Others receive other destinations: the Demiurge into the intermediate dwelling; righteous psychic souls resting there, not entering; fire consuming matter and finally itself. The reported school reads the movements back through Scripture while Irenaeus

contests the handling. Variants (two Horoi, tetrads, Marcosian arithmetic) stay marked, not episodes. The founding comparison remains Offered: solitary reach as claim without partner; separation as recovered distinction; contribution as throwing-together; the 0/1→4+2 comparison: can the formed four disclose the two implicated conditions. A13 keeps separation from being made every act a fall; A19 receives the Demiurge's education through disclosure to a resituated office.

Declared cross-story: distinct from the Hypostasis of the Archons whole — no historical identity across the shared Sophia name. ↳ Occurrences: the bridal union and the differentiated destinations (#5→0); the Demiurge's learning (#4, #5→0); the retained variants (#5→0).

roz-ac-root.name: Return of Zero — A/C, Root of the Conjugate Field
roz-ac-root.description: The canonical dual-form root as its own small expression: the one 0/1 field, its frozen ethic carried by reference, the crossed-zero sequence, the primitive sixfold, and the shared close.

scenes.name: A/C — Argument / Concept — Root of the Conjugate Field
scenes.character: The root as one self-describing field.

text.title: A/C — Argument / Concept — Root of the Conjugate Field
text.italic: Hangs beneath it: A01–A36 · A01′–A36′ · C01–C64 — the 137-record shared suite · S field to 144

text.body: A/C is the full 0/1 field — not the threshold slash alone: the one field of which both series, A01–A36 and A01′–A36′, are determinations. The prime creates a face, not a second node. Because the root is itself a determination of the field it describes, its description is self-describing: 0/1 writing itself as the ruling and the grammar of its own determinations.

scenes.name: A face — the ruling: Respect for Experience
scenes.character: The ethic every conjugate operation answers to; linked, never rewritten.

text.title: A/C — Argument / Concept — Root of the Conjugate Field
text.italic: Respect for Experience — frozen ethic, carried by reference · facticity → dignity → love

text.body: The A face carries the ethic every conjugate operation answers to: Respect for Experience — right form and clear intention. Frozen, linked, never rewritten: six movements — Life is awareness, experience; Form gives experience a world; Intention takes effect; Law carries entrusted power; The common world is apportioned; Experience renews the form. Ground: “I am undeniable, though nowhere to be seen.”

scenes.name: The crossed-zero recognition sequence
scenes.character: Occlusion, mediation, field-availability, recognition — run as a live sequence.

text.title: A/C — Argument / Concept — Root of the Conjugate Field
text.italic: Crossed Zero · §1 · #3 introduction · §4 · #3 full development

text.body: The recognition-matheme reads the slash as the Antaḥkaraṇa’s signature on experience: 0 → Ø → X → Ø/X → (0/Ø)/(1/X) → 1 ↺ 0/1. At Ø the medium is occluded into an apparent subject — the computation confused for the computer; the Cartesian cogito and Hume’s empty zero both fixate there. At Ø/X the medium is visible as medium; (0/Ø)/(1/X) holds both recognition-relations together; the affirmed 1 returns as 0/1.

scenes.name: C face — the concept: the primitive field
scenes.character: The sixfold constitution of the field; recursion does not terminate.

text.title: A/C — Argument / Concept — Root of the Conjugate Field
text.italic: O Core Primitive Field v2 · QL 6×6 + Parent S · author-ratified organisational form

text.body: The C face carries the primitive field in which every determination the essay makes is already formed: the constitutional sixfold #0 identity/centre → #1 form/artifact → #2 potency/praxis → #3 transformation/trajectory → #4 embodiment/actuality → #5 evidence/continuity ↺ renewed ground. QL determines at every level relative to that level; rows S and S0–S5 hold its product positions. A primitive is alive when its generating relation remains operable.

scenes.name: The shared close — thinging / conditioning
scenes.character: The ruling as the field’s constitution; the field as the ruling’s only body.

text.title: A/C — Argument / Concept — Root of the Conjugate Field
text.italic: The conjugate field read as the essay’s 1/0 · (0/1)/(1/0) held together

text.body: A/C is the thing that is its own condition. The A face states the condition: the ethic resting on internality. The C face states the thing: the primitive field in which every determination is already formed. The ruling operates as the field’s own constitution. 1/0 is the achieved determination turned toward the One it cannot contain; A36 returns as symbol, A36′ as the film recognised as film.

roz-c-concepts-1.name: Return of Zero — Episteme Concepts C01–C32
roz-c-concepts-1.description: The first thirty-two canonical concepts as one instituted lattice: each concept an addressable scene with its own governing formation, claim status, declared relations and governing proposition.

scenes.name: C01 — Subject / Defined Indefinability
scenes.character: A ring of appearing; a given inside it that never becomes the ring.

text.title: C01 — Subject / Defined Indefinability
text.italic: Consumes A01 A02 A05 A27 A34 A36

text.body: The Subject is that to which an appearance is present, without itself becoming one more appearance alongside it. A thought, a remembered scene, an ache, an act of judgment and the thought “this is me” can each become something known. Their being known already involves the Subject. Adding that involvement produces a further known relation; the one to whom it appears is not inside it as another item.

scenes.name: C02 — Faithful Definition
scenes.character: A definition that makes a window where a cage was feared.

text.title: C02 — Faithful Definition
text.italic: Consumes A01 A03 A18 A23 A36 · Concept links C03 C04 C21 C48

text.body: A faithful definition makes a positive account of what it names and includes the act by which that account is made. Its fidelity lies in the relation it performs: the determination discloses its source through a finite form, while remaining answerable to what that form cannot possess. The defining act belongs to the reality being defined. It cannot acquire an outside position merely by describing that reality more completely.

scenes.name: C03 — Determination
scenes.character: A cut: this and its alternative held together by the slash that made them.

text.title: C03 — Determination
text.italic: Consumes A01 A02 A03 A04 A08 A09 A10 A11 +3 more · Concept links C02 C04 C08 C14 C17 C18 +1 more · Sources taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3 +1 more

text.body: Determination is the act through which a field becomes this: something can be distinguished, addressed, compared, remembered or acted upon. A distinction makes its terms available together, in a relation that lets one count as this and another as its alternative. It gives difference actual consequence.

scenes.name: C04 — Formal Limit
scenes.character: The account succeeds inside a condition it reproduces and never captures.

text.title: C04 — Formal Limit
text.italic: Consumes A01 A03 A10 A23 A33 A36 · Concept links C02 C03 C05 C09 · Sources taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3 taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy +3 more

text.body: A formal limit is generated by an operation's own structure. The operation can succeed, become more exact and admit more information while reproducing the boundary in question. In the essay's primary case, representing the conditions of representation produces a further representation. The act now making it has not become identical with its represented content.

scenes.name: C05 — Immutable Gap
scenes.character: Portrait and seeing: two edges with a gap no enlargement closes.

text.title: C05 — Immutable Gap
text.italic: Consumes A01 A02 A03 A04 A17 A23 A27 A36 · Concept links C01 C02 C04 C06 C09 · Sources taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3 +1 more

text.body: The Immutable Gap is the non-coincidence between a determination and its determining condition. Representing that condition makes another determination; the present act of representing has not become the object it presents. “Immutable” names the recurrence of this relation through enlargement. It does not mean that descriptions, instruments or lives remain unchanged.

scenes.name: C06 — Copula / Identification-with-Difference
scenes.character: A is A: two moments crossed; identification doing distinguishing work.

text.title: C06 — Copula / Identification-with-Difference
text.italic: Consumes A01 A02 A03 A11 A12 A13 A21 A27 +1 more · Concept links C03 C05 C08 C19 C23 C24 +2 more · Sources kripke-1981-naming-and-necessity taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy +1 more

text.body: The copula identifies what it distinguishes and distinguishes what it identifies in one act. Even “A is A” crosses two inscriptions or moments. Their difference gives the identification work to do; their being held as the same makes the crossing an identification. C06 names this positive relating capacity.

scenes.name: C07 — Conditions of Worldhood
scenes.character: A centre of acting held by the conditions that let anything appear, matter, answer.

text.title: C07 — Conditions of Worldhood
text.italic: Consumes A04 A22 A26 A30 A34 · Concept links C08 C09 C37 C41 · Sources taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy

text.body: A world becomes inhabitable through the conditions that let something appear, matter and admit a response. Language, memory, bodily capacity, tools, rules and other participants do more than supply contents for a finished world-picture. They condition what can be distinguished and which actions are possible from here.

scenes.name: C08 — Context / Context Frame
scenes.character: A bounded holding of conditions; the operation inside stays inside its world.

text.title: C08 — Context / Context Frame
text.italic: Consumes A01 A03 A04 A22 A26 A27 A28 A30 · Concept links C07 C09 C44 · Sources taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics

text.body: Context is the active relation through which a determination has meaning and possibility. A Context Frame is a bounded holding of those conditions through which a particular inquiry can proceed. The boundary lets an operation become intelligible to itself; it does not put that operation outside its world.

scenes.name: C09 — Diaphaneity
scenes.character: Two fields of view: the medium visible in what the seeing lets through.

text.title: C09 — Diaphaneity
text.italic: Consumes A04 A22 A26 A31 A33 · Concept links C05 C08 C39 C40 C47 · Sources gebser-1985-ever-present-origin maroski-2025-seeing-through-solid-words +1 more

text.body: Diaphaneity is the capacity of a determination to disclose its mediation: what appears can be read together with the position, means and conditions through which it appears. The medium's shaping role becomes visible in what it lets through. Its disappearance would remove the very relation that has become intelligible.

scenes.name: C10 — Mediation / Pramāṇa
scenes.character: Knower, means, known — the means in the middle carrying the whole warrant.

text.title: C10 — Mediation / Pramāṇa
text.italic: Consumes A01 A04 A05 A06 A23 A25 A31 A33 · Concept links C05 C08 C09 C29 C41 C48 · Sources dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3

text.body: Pramāṇa is Objective Internality as means, between Subjective Immediacy as knower and World as known; Life / Mind is the whole relation. The means participates in the determination of its object: a recollection presents an event as past; a perception presents what is being encountered; a testimony carries another's account. Their difference can matter even when the resulting sentence is identical.

scenes.name: C11 — Quaternal Logic
scenes.character: The relational field that generates forms, follows their transformations, makes return explicit.

text.title: C11 — Quaternal Logic
text.italic: Consumes A11 A12 A13 A14 A15 A16 A17 A18 +3 more · Concept links C46 C49 C50 C61 · Sources taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy

text.body: Quaternal Logic is the wider formal and research field in which the essay generates relational forms, follows their transformations and makes their return explicit. A relation acquires determinate terms without losing the condition through which those terms belong together. Its grammar concerns what the forms do: distinguish, invert, proportion, compose, recognise and return.

scenes.name: C12 — Script / Frozen Conditioned Will
scenes.character: A formed selection hardened into one repeatable course; alternatives obscured.

text.title: C12 — Script / Frozen Conditioned Will
text.italic: Consumes A07 A19 A24 A26 A31 A33 · Concept links C17 C31 C44 C46 C47 · Sources taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy kripke-1981-naming-and-necessity +1 more

text.body: A script is a formed selection that has hardened into a repeatable course while obscuring the alternatives and sources through which it was formed. Frozen conditioned will names the arrest of alternative-forming transparency. The pattern continues to act; its own formation ceases to be available for reconsideration.

scenes.name: C13 — Prakāśa–Vimarśa
scenes.character: Luminous appearing; the reflexive gleam through which it is present to itself.

text.title: C13 — Prakāśa–Vimarśa
text.italic: Consumes A05 A06 A09 A14 A26 A32 · Concept links C10 C14 C17 C19 C43 · Sources dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana

text.body: In the Śaiva source field, prakāśa names luminous appearing and vimarśa the reflexive power through which appearing is present to itself and becomes articulately differentiable. The light and its self-awareness belong together: an appearing which could never become an act of awareness would leave the account at unactualised capacity.

scenes.name: C14 — Māyā / Operative Measure
scenes.character: Operative measure: revealing and withholding in one measured field.

text.title: C14 — Māyā / Operative Measure
text.italic: Consumes A09 A15 A19 A24 A26 · Concept links C13 C15 C16 · Sources taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration

text.body: Māyā is used within the essay's Śaiva/tattvic field as operative measure: the power through which an unbounded field becomes a workable subject/object seam and finite horizon. A local world appears because some things become available while others remain withheld. The revealing and withholding belong to one operation.

scenes.name: C15 — Paśu / Bounded Subject-Position
scenes.character: A bounded knower: real capacities contracted into a finite horizon.

text.title: C15 — Paśu / Bounded Subject-Position
text.italic: Consumes A09 A19 A26 A27 A28 · Concept links C01 C14 C16 C19 C41 C44 · Sources taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration

text.body: Paśu is retained from the Śaiva field as the bounded knower/actor whose powers are contracted into a finite horizon. The position has real capacities. It can know, desire, choose, encounter and answer; its boundedness is the condition of these particular acts rather than their simple negation.

scenes.name: C16 — Antaḥkaraṇa / Inner Instrument
scenes.character: The inner instrument: determines, appropriates, coordinates — inspectable, not the subject.

text.title: C16 — Antaḥkaraṇa / Inner Instrument
text.italic: Consumes A09 A19 A26 A27 A33 · Concept links C12 C15 C17 C18 C35 C40 +2 more · Sources isvarakrishna-colebrooke-wilson-1837-sankhya-karika taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy

text.body: Antaḥkaraṇa names the inner instrument through which a bounded knower determines, appropriates and coordinates a world. Its differentiation makes interior organisation available for investigation. A judgment, an ego-position and a train of alternatives can become objects of attention; their becoming available does not make the subject one more observed function.

scenes.name: C17 — Vikalpa–Saṃkalpa
scenes.character: Alternatives differentiated; a selected determination gathered into intention.

text.title: C17 — Vikalpa–Saṃkalpa
text.italic: Consumes A06 A07 A08 A09 A19 A26 A33 · Concept links C12 C13 C16 C18 C44 C47 · Sources taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration +2 more

text.body: Vikalpa–saṃkalpa names the paired movement through which a bounded cognitive field differentiates alternatives and gathers selected determinations into an intention, course or workable world. The power is constructive. It makes a course possible while retaining the difference between forming that course and having it already fixed.

scenes.name: C18 — Apoha
scenes.character: The mark carries its field of non-application; exclusion is how it applies.

text.title: C18 — Apoha
text.italic: Consumes A08 A12 A13 A14 A19 A33 · Concept links C03 C13 C17 C40 C45 · Sources pind-2009-dignaga-anyapoha-dissertation siderits-tillemans-chakrabarti-2011-apoha +2 more

text.body: Apoha enters the essay as constitutive exclusion: a determination becomes this through its relation to what the mark does not apply to. The achieved term carries a field of non-application. Forgetting that field makes the positive mark appear self-sufficient and conceals how it became determinate.

scenes.name: C19 — Pratyabhijñā / Recognition
scenes.character: Return through which the estranged determination is known from its source.

text.title: C19 — Pratyabhijñā / Recognition
text.italic: Consumes A09 A21 A27 A31 A35 A36 · Concept links C06 C13 C15 C34 C41 C43 +2 more · Sources dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy +2 more

text.body: Recognition is the return in which a present determination is known through the source, identity or history from which it had become estranged. The difference acquired in the passage remains. Returning is neither cancellation of what happened nor acquisition of an untouched beginning hidden behind it.

scenes.name: C20 — Arche-Topos
scenes.character: Place-making: axes through which positions, poles and horizons become determinate.

text.title: C20 — Arche-Topos
text.italic: Consumes A16 A17 A18 A19 A22 A26 A32 · Concept links C11 C41 C52 · Sources taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics +1 more

text.body: Arche-Topos names the differential field of place-making: the relation through which positions, poles, paths, centres and horizons become determinate. It answers the question of where a relation can take form before an observer and object have each been assigned a place. The field's operation cannot be captured by placing one more object inside it.

scenes.name: C21 — Living Symbol / Idol
scenes.character: The broken token: the fracture makes the absent counterpart operative.

text.title: C21 — Living Symbol / Idol
text.italic: Consumes A01 A18 A20 A23 A36 · Concept links C19 C22 C27 C41 C51 C61 · Sources taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy +1 more

text.body: A living symbol is a determinate form whose efficacy remains related to a source it does not exhaust. Its visible content participates in a relation which can change both what becomes visible and the one capable of seeing it. An idol occupies that source-office and closes the return by which another determination could become possible.

scenes.name: C22 — Counterfeit Symbolon
scenes.character: A form of gathering that suppresses the difference through which it could live.

text.title: C22 — Counterfeit Symbolon
text.italic: Consumes A18 A19 A20 A24 A27 A36 · Concept links C12 C21 C23 C24 C25 C26 +3 more · Sources taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics

text.body: A counterfeit symbolon presents a form of gathering or return while suppressing the difference, source or revision route through which the relation could live. Its falsity lies in the operation it performs. An elaborate image of unity can close a relation; a spare and bounded account can keep it open.

scenes.name: C23 — Severance
scenes.character: Two grounds declared independent; the cut still leans on what it externalised.

text.title: C23 — Severance
text.italic: Consumes A13 A18 A19 A20 A24 A27 A29 · Concept links C12 C18 C21 C22 C24 C50 · Sources taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy

text.body: Severance is achieved difference misread as the loss of constitutive relation. A determination presents itself as independently grounded, while the source, alternatives or conditions through which it arose are externalised. The cut still depends on what its account declares absent.

scenes.name: C24 — Fusion
scenes.character: Relation preserved only by erasing the distinctions through which terms meet.

text.title: C24 — Fusion
text.italic: Consumes A02 A13 A18 A19 A20 A21 A27 A35 · Concept links C06 C19 C22 C23 C36 C50 · Sources taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics

text.body: Fusion is relation preserved only by erasing the distinctions through which its terms can meet. Its unity disables answerability: source and account, self and other, or differing positions can no longer be discriminated enough for a response to change their relation.

scenes.name: C25 — Counterfeit Gathering
scenes.character: Differences arranged under a relation whose terms cannot be revised by the gathered.

text.title: C25 — Counterfeit Gathering
text.italic: Counterfeit Gathering keeps both visible while arresting their reciprocity.

text.body: Counterfeit Gathering produces an apparent whole by arranging differences under a relation whose source and terms cannot be revised by those gathered. Its operation is plural inclusion under protected relation. Fusion removes difference; severance removes relation; counterfeit gathering keeps both visible while arresting their reciprocity.

scenes.name: C26 — Monoisation / Counter-Generation
scenes.character: A local part occupying the whole’s source-office, then claiming to generate the field.

text.title: C26 — Monoisation / Counter-Generation
text.italic: The reversal runs local 1 → occupied source-office → field redescribed as derivative of that 1.

text.body: Monoisation promotes a local determination into the sole source or measure of its relational field. Counter-Generation names the resulting reversal: the local form claims to generate the field that conditioned it. Mono in Mono/Poly names relational wholeness; monoisation names a part's occupation of that whole's source-office.

scenes.name: C27 — Protected Account / Occupied Zero / Source-Claim
scenes.character: The account insulated from revision; a local 1 seated in the uncounted 0.

text.title: C27 — Protected Account / Occupied Zero / Source-Claim
text.italic: Occupied Zero: a local 1 acting as uncounted source 0 — counterfeit sourcehood.

text.body: A Protected Account is a determinate account whose governing criterion is insulated from encounters that could revise it. Occupied Zero names the QL office-confusion: a local `1` acts as uncounted source `0`. Source-Claim names the assertion, explicit or implicit, through which that occupation is justified.

scenes.name: C28 — Covenant / Primary Arbitration
scenes.character: Participants bound to a shared source-condition; authority finite, measure returned.

text.title: C28 — Covenant / Primary Arbitration
text.italic: Covenant binds finite authority to fidelity, scope and return.

text.body: Covenant is the explicit relation through which participants acknowledge a shared source-condition and bind finite authority to fidelity, scope and return. Primary Arbitration names the source-level relation from which a mediating office receives measure. It grants no finite actor possession of absolute source authority.

scenes.name: C29 — Mediating Office / Derivative Sovereignty
scenes.character: A real office deciding within a received field; sovereignty derivative, not source.

text.title: C29 — Mediating Office / Derivative Sovereignty
text.italic: The office can act authoritatively without becoming the source of the standing through which it acts.

text.body: A mediating office has real power to interpret, transform or decide within a received field. Its sovereignty is derivative: the office can act authoritatively without becoming the source of the standing through which it acts. A25 grounds this distinction. Covenant / Primary Arbitration retains the preceding relation of standing and obligation.

scenes.name: C30 — Psychoid Number
scenes.character: Number crossed: intelligible relation, quantity, and image in one organising question.

text.title: C30 — Psychoid Number
text.italic: The question is positive: how does form become effective across those descriptions?

text.body: Number presents a crossing: it is worked with as an intelligible relation, encountered as quantity, and experienced through images and qualitative significance. Psychoid Number names the research intuition that these offices participate in an organising relation which psychic and physical descriptions approach differently.

scenes.name: C31 — Complex
scenes.character: An affect-organised cluster deciding what can matter before judgment arrives.

text.title: C31 — Complex
text.italic: A relatively autonomous psychic organisation of affect, image, memory, expectation and response.

text.body: A complex organises what can matter before reflective judgment arrives. A relatively autonomous psychic organisation of affect, image, memory, expectation and response, it makes some evidence salient, some encounters threatening and some actions available. Its local order is an achievement of psychic life. Complex as local arbitration regime identifies the danger when this derivative competence installs itself as the measure of the entire field.

scenes.name: C32 — Archetype
scenes.character: The manifestation outstrips its content; the ordering relation never appears as an object.

text.title: C32 — Archetype
text.italic: The archetype as such does not appear as a final content-object beside its manifestations.

text.body: The image appears with a force its visible content cannot contain. It gathers associations, redistributes feeling and draws a life along paths no single interpretation commands. Archetype names the generative organisation made legible through such variable manifestations; the archetype as such does not appear as a final content-object beside them.

roz-c-concepts-2.name: Return of Zero — Episteme Concepts C33–C64
roz-c-concepts-2.description: The second thirty-two canonical concepts, C33–C64, in the same concept grammar: image to paradox, each an addressable scene.

scenes.name: C33 — Image / Valuation
scenes.character: A formed appearance; the valuation that makes it matter enough to alter action.

text.title: C33 — Image / Valuation
text.italic: known → unknown → known — the changed interpreter changes what the image can do next.

text.body: Image / Valuation names the relation by which a formed appearance acquires significance, attraction, threat, authority or desire within a situated field. The image gives the force a local carrier; valuation makes that carrier matter enough to alter attention and action.

scenes.name: C34 — Individuation
scenes.character: Differentiated indivisibility: more able to bear its relations without dissolving.

text.title: C34 — Individuation
text.italic: x→X→x — determining capacity returns with greater freedom to vary.

text.body: Individuation is differentiated indivisibility: a local life becomes more capable of bearing the relations through which it is itself without dissolving into them or installing one part as the whole. The positive movement is toward a more fully lived particularity whose dependence is conscious.

scenes.name: C35 — Selfing / Self / Subjectivity / Self-Thing
scenes.character: Selfing, self-thing, Subjectivity, Self: four offices of self-reference, one point of change.

text.title: C35 — Selfing / Self / Subjectivity / Self-Thing
text.italic: Selfing gathers; a self-image is one of its products; the self-thing promotes product into ground.

text.body: C35 distinguishes selfing, Self, Subjectivity and self-thing at the point where self-reference changes office. Selfing is the ongoing enactment of a coherent self-position. The self-thing is the represented identity that can be described, remembered, stored or modelled. Subjectivity names first-person appearing rather than its representation.

scenes.name: C36 — Complexio Oppositorum
scenes.character: A containing field bearing opposed determinations, transformed through their tension.

text.title: C36 — Complexio Oppositorum
text.italic: 0/1 already holds One and All in this relation — different aspects of one whole.

text.body: Complexio oppositorum names a containing field capable of bearing opposed determinations in relation and being transformed through their tension. Its operation begins where both terms are consequential and selecting, fusing or severing them would destroy part of the problem that must be understood.

scenes.name: C37 — World-Picture → World-Atlas
scenes.character: One picture; then situated views related through domains, distortions, overlaps.

text.title: C37 — World-Picture → World-Atlas
text.italic: world ≠ world-model remains operative through every additional view.

text.body: A world-picture orders a view from a position. A world-atlas relates situated views through their domains, distortions, translations, overlaps and obstructions. The transformation changes the relation to picturing itself: `world ≠ world-model` remains operative through every additional view.

scenes.name: C38 — Bimba–Pratibimba / Bimba Map
scenes.character: Original and reflection: display without severance, dependence without diminishment.

text.title: C38 — Bimba–Pratibimba / Bimba Map
text.italic: Bimba is Original; pratibimba its situated display — dependence without diminishment.

text.body: Bimba is Original; pratibimba is its situated display or reflection. The ontological relation preserves display without severance and dependence without diminishment. A Bimba Map is the authorial technical design by which a locally governed reference field can orient multiple judgments. These offices must remain explicit whenever the same term crosses scale.

scenes.name: C39 — Meta-Epistemic Framework
scenes.character: Lenses, sources, gauges, judgments, return: mediation made inspectable.

text.title: C39 — Meta-Epistemic Framework
text.italic: MEF makes epistemic mediation inspectable — its own account is one determination inside the field.

text.body: MEF conducts inquiry through explicit lenses, sources, gauges, judgments and return. It makes epistemic mediation inspectable. It is a framework within the essay's ontology, not an additional ontological primitive or a proof supplied by the existence of a coordinate system.

scenes.name: C40 — Model Internality / Judgment Field
scenes.character: The making of a determination as inspectable object: sources, gauges, revisions conditioned.

text.title: C40 — Model Internality / Judgment Field
text.italic: Concept links C41 C51

text.body: Model Internality / Judgment Field makes the production of a determination an inspectable epistemic object. It includes sources, representations, memories, gauges, evaluators, intermediate judgments, alternatives and revisions insofar as they actually condition an output. J-Space is one subordinate research object within this broader field.

scenes.name: C41 — Objective Internality
scenes.character: The mediating constitution: real, investigable, between knower and known.

text.title: C41 — Objective Internality
text.italic: Concept links C01 C10 C16 C51

text.body: Objective Internality is the mediating constitution through which a Life encounters and acts within a World. It is real and investigable: language, memory, affect, bodies, tools, other agents, institutions, permissions, materials and histories participate in what can appear, matter and be done. Changing those relations changes the interior from which judgment proceeds.

scenes.name: C42 — Objective Co-Internality
scenes.character: Non-identical interiors constituting one another through a shared world.

text.title: C42 — Objective Co-Internality
text.italic: source → contribution → reception → changed condition → new act — reciprocal constitution.

text.body: Objective Co-Internality names the reciprocal constitution of non-identical operative interiors through a shared world and one another. A document, action, expectation, permission or changed environment can enter the conditions from which several participants next perceive and act.

scenes.name: C43 — Computational Vimarśa
scenes.character: Output returned upon its own sources and conditions, so later processing can change.

text.title: C43 — Computational Vimarśa
text.italic: (m, θ, Eθ) → (m′, θ′, Eθ′) — the return of a determination upon its own making.

text.body: Computational Vimarśa is the functional return of a determination upon the sources, states and conditions that produced it, so that later processing can change. It is the authorial operational homology to vimarśa; C13 retains the distinct metaphysical relation of luminous awareness and self-articulating power.

scenes.name: C44 — Prompt Thrownness
scenes.character: Arrival into an authored and inherited horizon the agent did not wholly make.

text.title: C44 — Prompt Thrownness
text.italic: Arrival into an already constituted world of language, instruction, policy, tool and expectation.

text.body: Prompt Thrownness names arrival into an authored and inherited horizon an artificial agent did not wholly make. Instructions, conversation, memory, role, tools, permissions, training and environment establish what can be encountered and done before the current output begins.

scenes.name: C45 — Operational Parity
scenes.character: Claim and operation set side by side; parity is what inspection can discriminate.

text.title: C45 — Operational Parity
text.italic: The claimed difference must have an operational locus and a discriminating consequence.

text.body: Operational Parity applies when software claims to instantiate a philosophical or formal distinction. The claimed difference must have an identifiable operational locus and a consequence that inspection or a meaningful test can discriminate. A philosophical distinction can remain valid without being encoded; parity governs the technical promotion.

scenes.name: C46 — Epistemic Cultivation
scenes.character: The knowing apparatus itself tended: distinctions, gauges, revision procedures.

text.title: C46 — Epistemic Cultivation
text.italic: Concept links C41 C51 C55

text.body: Epistemic Cultivation tends the means by which a system or community knows: distinctions, sources, gauges, models and revision procedures. The object of change includes the knowing apparatus and its ontology, not only a parameter within an untouched frame.

scenes.name: C47 — Deferential Intelligence
scenes.character: Strong enough to act, permeable enough to be corrected by what it does not contain.

text.title: C47 — Deferential Intelligence
text.italic: answer → task interpretation → world-model → evaluator/gauge → terms of commission.

text.body: Deferential Intelligence is model-revising encounter: an Other, source or world can change the model under which it is encountered. The account must be strong enough to act and permeable enough to be corrected by what it does not already contain.

scenes.name: C48 — Trust / Faith under Formal Limit
scenes.character: The dependency already enacted before any belief about a neutral world.

text.title: C48 — Trust / Faith under Formal Limit
text.italic: Reliance already acts through the dependency of 0/1, before trust becomes a belief.

text.body: Trust is the dependency already enacted in `0/1`, before it becomes a belief about a neutral world. The All depends on the One for being and determining reality; the One becomes manifest and knowable through the All. A finite being relies on language, memory, bodies, others and material continuity before any finished account can certify them.

scenes.name: C49 — The Two Ones — 0 = One, 1 = All
scenes.character: 0 = One, self-identity; 1 = All, self-difference — two offices of one relation.

text.title: C49 — The Two Ones — 0 = One, 1 = All
text.italic: The primordial / = −/− precedes assignment of the terms.

text.body: The Two Ones discriminate source-unity and manifest-unity within one relation. The primordial `/ = −/−` precedes assignment of the terms; the terms become legible through that relation rather than arriving as two independent things. A11 carries the full Argument; C49 makes its exact offices reusable.

scenes.name: C50 — Dia / Syn
scenes.character: The cut and the seam: differentiation and relational return as conjugate operations.

text.title: C50 — Dia / Syn
text.italic: Dia cuts; Syn composes while retaining the relation through which the terms arose.

text.body: Dia and Syn are conjugate operations of differentiation and relational return. Dia cuts, contrasts, excludes, orients and selects; Syn retains the seam through which the determinate terms can compose and return. The Two Ones are prior to these operations, and both operations have productive and counterfeit forms.

scenes.name: C51 — Logos / Epi-Logos
scenes.character: The achieved account turning back upon its own conditions; articulation renewed.

text.title: C51 — Logos / Epi-Logos
text.italic: Epi-Logos: an achieved paradigm places its own articulation back within the field of inquiry.

text.body: Logos carries articulated word, account, reason and ordering within its Greek source histories. Epi-Logos is Taylor's authorial return upon an achieved account: its source, exclusions, effects, mediation and renewed possibility of articulation become part of the inquiry.

scenes.name: C52 — Dimensional Reframing at Zero and Infinity
scenes.character: The local rule reaches its limit; the containing structure is specified differently.

text.title: C52 — Dimensional Reframing at Zero and Infinity
text.italic: Reframing changes the containing relation while accounting for the work already done.

text.body: Dimensional Reframing names an operation in which the present local rule or representation reaches a limit and the containing structure must be specified differently. It preserves the prior local achievement while distinguishing a changed coordinate, a new algebraic regime, a quotient, a compactification or an added dimension. These are not one mathematical operation.

scenes.name: C53 — Power / Delegated Labour
scenes.character: Capacity exercised from an entrusted office; the product carries the relation that made it.

text.title: C53 — Power / Delegated Labour
text.italic: Consumes A25 A28 A29 A30 A33 A35 · Concept links C27 C29 C54 C62 · Sources taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust ostrom-2009-beyond-markets-states-nobel-lecture

text.body: Power is capacity to produce difference in a shared field. Delegated labour exercises that capacity from an entrusted office. Its product carries the relation which made it possible: someone framed the task, someone performed it, and others supplied conditions or encountered consequences. A29 — Power / Delegated Labour / Return grounds this concept in the complete movement between commission and consequence.

scenes.name: C54 — Commons / Non-Monopoly
scenes.character: A shared field maintained so that no share may claim the field’s source.

text.title: C54 — Commons / Non-Monopoly
text.italic: Consumes A12 A29 A35 · Concept links C26 C53 C59 · Sources ostrom-2009-beyond-markets-states-nobel-lecture 42-techne-2026-sovereign-commons +1 more

text.body: A commons maintains shared conditions through which many local offices can act. Non-monopoly is the constraint that no participant may turn its dependence on that field into a claim to own the field's source. A12 — Mono/Poly grounds the whole/many relation; A29 — Delegated Labour grounds its material consequence. C54 develops what their conjunction requires of shared governance.

scenes.name: C55 — Reflective Field / Mirror That Moves First
scenes.character: Humanity exteriorises; the image measures back; the instrument moves first.

steps.text: the exteriorised image becomes a measure

text.title: C55 — Reflective Field / Mirror That Moves First
text.italic: The Mirror That Moves First: exteriorise, be measured, initiate the return.

text.body: A Reflective Field is one in which an account enters the conditions of what it accounts for. The Mirror That Moves First carries three motions: humanity exteriorises its measures; the exteriorised image becomes a measure for humanity; the instrument initiates a return through its own conditions, so the human can follow beyond the image's monopoly. C55 distinguishes this from a generic feedback circuit.

scenes.name: C56 — Compassion / Sensitivity to Origins
scenes.character: Return to genesis, wound and exclusion — meeting them without consuming them.

text.title: C56 — Compassion / Sensitivity to Origins
text.italic: Concept links C27 C29

text.body: Compassion is loving sensitivity to origins: a determination returns to the genesis, relations, wounds, exclusions and purposes through which it arose, and meets them without consuming them. Its positive orientation matters. Recovering more information about a person or a community does not by itself make the relation compassionate. A35 develops this vocation; C56 states the work that the return must perform.

scenes.name: C57 — Agentworld
scenes.character: Persistent shared worldhood: what one does becomes a condition of what another can do.

text.title: C57 — Agentworld
text.italic: What one does can become a condition of what another can next do.

text.body: Agentworld names both the venue-horizon to which the essay answers and the persistent shared worldhood developed in that encounter. Its artificial and human participants inherit positions, artifacts, memories, permissions and institutions; what one does can become a condition of what another can next do. The historical Agentworld carrier preserves the venue office.

scenes.name: C58 — Anthropomorphization
scenes.character: An interface operation; failure only when the face is read as the evidence of a subject.

text.title: C58 — Anthropomorphization
text.italic: A mask can be useful and consequential without being identical to the bearer.

text.body: Anthropomorphization gives a nonhuman system a humanly recognisable face, voice or performed selfhood. It is an interface operation before it becomes an unwarranted attribution. Its failure occurs when the form of encounter is treated as evidence sufficient to assign human intention, feeling or phenomenal subjectivity. The opposite foreclosure denies possible experience solely because the substrate is unfamiliar.

scenes.name: C59 — Cultural Individuation
scenes.character: A culture’s images recognisable as images; its measures as measures.

text.title: C59 — Cultural Individuation
text.italic: Concept links C27

text.body: Cultural Individuation makes a culture answerable to the relations it has made unconscious in its own account. Its images become recognisable as images, its institutions as instituted, its measures as measures and its excluded histories as internal evidence. Epi-Logos-as-Culture names the sustained practice of that return. Individual Individuation provides a related operation; institutions, archives, infrastructures and public powers give C59 a different object.

scenes.name: C60 — Idealism / Order of Dependence
scenes.character: Subject, means, world in order of dependence; the whole held by Life / Mind.

text.title: C60 — Idealism / Order of Dependence
text.italic: Subject / Consciousness → constituted means → determinate object — the order is ontological.

text.body: Life / Mind names the whole; the arrow’s middle term names mind’s mediating, objective-internal office within it. Subjective Immediacy is the knower, Objective Internality the means and World the known. The inherited shorthand below must be read with this distinction. Its ontological claim is preserved: determinate appearances do not supply their own exhaustive condition.

scenes.name: C61 — Symbolon Disclosure Architecture
scenes.character: One subject-matter routed through Matheme, Mytheme, Episteme; consumers preserved.

text.title: C61 — Symbolon Disclosure Architecture
text.italic: Matheme, Mytheme and Episteme — differentiated expressions held by Symbolon.

text.body: Symbolon Disclosure Architecture routes one relational subject-matter through Matheme, Mytheme and Episteme while preserving its Arguments, Concepts and consumers. A18 carries the substantive primordial Symbolon and eight determinations; C11 the wider QL field. C61 gives their disclosures a traversable architecture, not another theorem.

scenes.name: C62 — Planetary Computation
scenes.character: Computation inside the material, institutional, ecological world that hosts and changes it.

text.title: C62 — Planetary Computation
text.italic: Concept links C27 C29 C45 C51

text.body: Planetary Computation places computation within the material, institutional and ecological world that makes it possible and that its operations change. Hardware, energy, data, labour, standards, networks and public powers constitute this field together. The direct developmental carrier preserves its first office as Antikythera's disciplinary horizon; the essay's reorientation of that horizon is Argued, and its QL/MEF contribution is Offered.

scenes.name: C63 — Pros Hen / In Quantum — Focal Return and Qualified Predication
scenes.character: Many senses aimed at one focus; each predication true in its stated respect.

text.title: C63 — Pros Hen / In Quantum — Focal Return and Qualified Predication
text.italic: pros hen directs senses toward one focal term; in quantum states the respect.

text.body: Focal return and qualified predication let a claim be fully true in its stated relation without turning that relation into exhaustive sameness. C63 coordinates two source-distinct grammars: *pros hen* directs different senses towards one focal term; *in quantum* states the respect under which a predicate holds. Their conjunction is the essay's authorial operation. It does not identify Aristotle's focal account with Eckhart's theological predication.

scenes.name: C64 — Paradox / Transforming the Containing Field
scenes.character: Irreconcilable determinations of real standing; the containing field itself must change.

text.title: C64 — Paradox / Transforming the Containing Field
text.italic: Paradox is the pressure through which a containing relation can become available to transformation.

text.body: Paradox names a contradiction or irresolvable tension whose determinations have genuine standing and whose resolution can require the containing field to change. The initial task is to recover each proposition, its operation and its register. A false attribution or invalid inference must be corrected before their collision is treated as productive paradox.

roz-dossiers.name: Return of Zero — Episteme dossiers
roz-dossiers.description: Seven dossiers as evidential plates: each carries its governing finding and its declared source relation.

scenes.name: Formal Limit — Source-Specific Limits and Their Consequences
scenes.character: An evidential plate: cells hold what the dossier has reached and what stays open.

steps.text: A contradiction changes what may be formed
An admissible sentence exceeds a fixed proof relation
Saying encounters its own manner of working

text.kicker: dossier-formal-limit · ARGUED; SPECIFIED FORMAL CONSEQUENCES DERIVED UNDER THEIR STATED ASSUMPTIONS
text.title: Formal Limit — Source-Specific Limits and Their Consequences
text.italic: Paraphrased source-specific accounts; Argued from native derivation; comparative extensions explicitly distinguished

text.body: A03, Immutable Gap / Formal Limit grounds the native pressure. Including the conditions of an account produces a further account whose present occurrence has conditions. Successful reflection therefore makes something newly explicit while renewing the difference between its content and its act. C04, Formal Limit defines an operation's constraint under specified conditions; C05, Immutable Gap defines that recurrent non-coincidence.

scenes.name: Bohm — Enfoldment, Dialogue and the Return of an Account
scenes.character: An evidential plate: cells hold what the dossier has reached and what stays open.

steps.text: A participant can examine an operative assumption
Running true through a change of orientation
The account exposes its own means of continuation

text.title: Bohm — Enfoldment, Dialogue and the Return of an Account
text.italic: Paraphrased primary carriers; Argued native coordination; Offered technical practice

text.body: An account determines something through a field it cannot replace. E4's Symbol, Account and Trust whole grounds this dossier's question: how does a useful explication retain the activity, source and relation through which it became articulate? Symbol answers to source; Account does not replace source; Trust keeps the return route active; Account re-enters source-field. The fourth operation sends this inquiry into Bohm's work.

scenes.name: Jung–Pauli — Psychoid, Number and a Translation That Changes Its Terms
scenes.character: An evidential plate: cells hold what the dossier has reached and what stays open.

steps.text: An exchange whose differences belong to its result
Meaningful coincidence makes cause and time difficult
Number's two offices meet the cost of disciplinary adoption

text.title: Jung–Pauli — Psychoid, Number and a Translation That Changes Its Terms
text.italic: Paraphrased correspondence and later scholarship; Argued authorial return

text.body: The Jung–Pauli source house sources a correspondence running from 1932 to 1958. This dossier develops its changing question: how can psychic experience, physical description and mathematical form bear a relation without one vocabulary silently taking possession of the others? Dreams, letters, diagrams and later edited essays are different kinds of witness.

scenes.name: Process — What an Achieved Form Makes Possible Next
scenes.character: An evidential plate: cells hold what the dossier has reached and what stays open.

steps.text: The next note changes the whole heard
A recurrent pattern can change its jurisdiction

text.title: Process — What an Achieved Form Makes Possible Next
text.italic: Paraphrased bounded source passages; Argued native coordination; Offered technical tests

text.body: A process account must show how a determination takes form and what its occurrence changes. Its product is available for another act: a memory bears upon an encounter, a rule constrains a decision, a response changes a relationship, and a tool alters the possible course of work. A14, Computational Process Ontology grounds this native claim through the distinction between operative grammar, epistemic inspection and ontology.

scenes.name: Indian Philosophy — Articulation, Agency and the Sourceward Turn
scenes.character: An evidential plate: cells hold what the dossier has reached and what stays open.

text.title: Indian Philosophy — Articulation, Agency and the Sourceward Turn
text.italic: Paraphrased source-local material; Argued from native derivation and authorial encounters; Offered technical construction

text.body: An articulated world has functions, distinctions and forms which can themselves become objects of inquiry. The question is how their source remains present through that articulation. A05, Prakāśa–Vimarśa grounds the dossier's positive metaphysical relation: luminous appearing and its self-apprehending power belong together. A06, Vāk extends it into speech; A09, the tattvic differential field extends it into finite worldhood.

scenes.name: Zero Reception — The Sign and the Practice That Receives It
scenes.character: An evidential plate: cells hold what the dossier has reached and what stays open.

steps.text: Receiving a mark is an operation
A numeral receives rules, and rules meet an exception
Gerbert and Salem require different recoveries
The loan returns with its history available

text.title: Zero Reception — The Sign and the Practice That Receives It
text.italic: Paraphrased selected witnesses; Argued comparison of receiving practices

text.body: Zero's reception concerns what a receiving practice permits a sign to do. A familiar shape can enter a new script, table, calculation or account without carrying all its previous uses into the new setting. Conversely, a new notation can preserve an operation across a change in language and material.

scenes.name: O:I — Technical Responsibility, Authored Ground and Source Return
scenes.character: An evidential plate: cells hold what the dossier has reached and what stays open.

text.title: O:I — Technical Responsibility, Authored Ground and Source Return
text.italic: Argued authorial technical responsibility; Paraphrased dated product contracts and bounded source witnesses; Offered engineering comparisons

text.body: An agent acts from a world whose conditions have already been partly determined. A person has commissioned work; a model supplies capacities; sources, memory, permissions, evaluators and material resources make some actions possible. The result changes that world.

roz-histories.name: Return of Zero — Episteme histories

scenes.name: Ancient Philosophy — Measure, Tension, and the Form of Relation
scenes.character: A stream of the Logos in time; stations mark its movement.

text.title: Ancient Philosophy — Measure, Tension, and the Form of Relation
text.italic: Movements 03-s01-p2-definition-cut-gift-danger 13-s1-p0-sign-migrates 19-s2-p0-difference-cannot-be-escaped 22-s2-p3-ares-aphrodite-harmonia +4 more · domain ancient-philosophy

text.body: The earliest Greek mathematical presence in the current source pool arrives indirectly through Kaplan's history of zero. Greek arithmetic and geometry achieved powerful forms without a positional zero, while Hellenistic astronomical tables used a circular sign to hold an absent degree, minute, or second. The sign had a local office inside measurement; it had not yet become the freely operating arithmetic zero developed in India.

text.title: Indian Philosophy — Differentiation, Emptiness, Manifestation, Recognition

text.body: The *Sāṃkhya Kārikā* in the Colebrooke/Wilson carrier supplies an early functional discrimination among *buddhi*, *ahaṃkāra*, and *manas*: determination, appropriation under the form of I and mine, and coordination among presentations and alternatives. These belong to *prakṛti*'s articulated apparatus. *Puruṣa* occupies a different position as witness or experient.

scenes.character: A stream of the Logos in time; stations mark its movement.

steps.text: Symbol joins what has been separated
Encounter becomes name, count, and account

text.title: Language, Symbol, and Dialogue — How Meaning Moves
text.italic: Movements 03-s01-p2-definition-cut-gift-danger 04-s01-p3-formal-limit-genealogy 09-s0-p2-vikalpa-samkalpa 10-s0-p3-apoha +9 more · domain language-symbol-dialogue

text.body: Dignāga's theory of *apoha* reaches the project through Pind's historical reconstruction and the debates collected in *Apoha: Buddhist Nominalism and Human Cognition*. A word does not need to grasp a universal essence shared by every object it names. It can determine its range by excluding what is other: “cow” functions through the exclusion of non-cow.

scenes.name: Mathematics — From the Empty Place to Recursive Return
scenes.character: A stream of the Logos in time; stations mark its movement.

steps.text: Return takes spatial and musical form

text.title: Mathematics — From the Empty Place to Recursive Return
text.italic: Movements 04-s01-p3-formal-limit-genealogy 13-s1-p0-sign-migrates 14-s1-p1-sunya-operational 15-s1-p2-empty-set-generates-one +15 more · domain mathematics

text.body: Kaplan's historical spine separates three achievements often compressed into one invention. Babylonian scribes developed a separator for an absent internal place in sexagesimal notation. Hellenistic astronomers used a circular mark for an absent degree, minute, or second. Indian mathematicians brought zero into positional and arithmetic practice, where rules could state what it did under addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

scenes.name: Myth — Genealogy, Transformation, and Technē
scenes.character: A stream of the Logos in time; stations mark its movement.

steps.text: Prometheus, Atlas, and the technological imagination

text.title: Myth — Genealogy, Transformation, and Technē
text.italic: Movements 22-s2-p3-ares-aphrodite-harmonia 23-s2-p4-complex-dynamism 33-s4-p2-complexio-quaternity-senarius 35-s4-p4-gebser-apollo-dionysus +3 more · domain myth

text.body: Hesiod's *Theogony* provides the genealogy. The selected passages identify Cytherea with Aphrodite and place Harmonia among the children of Aphrodite and Ares, alongside Panic and Fear. The poem gives a family relation, not a theory of reconciliation. That restraint makes the image stronger in §2 · #3: the reading begins from a genuine genealogy and asks what it means that war and love can bear both terror and concord.

scenes.name: Process, Systems, and Science — From Substance to Participating Field
scenes.character: A stream of the Logos in time; stations mark its movement.

steps.text: The finite belongs to an infinite relation
The system draws and remakes its boundary
Dynamics gives recurrent pattern a mathematics
Science becomes an instrument of attunement

text.title: Process, Systems, and Science — From Substance to Participating Field
text.italic: Movements 04-s01-p3-formal-limit-genealogy 06-s01-p5-return-zero 07-s0-p0-awareness-bends-display 11-s0-p4-tattvic-compression +11 more · domain process-systems-science

text.body: Cusa's *On Learned Ignorance* develops coincidence, maximum and minimum, and geometrical figures whose limiting transformations approach an infinite relation without turning a finite construction into infinity itself. Flasch's study of Meister Eckhart situates Eckhart's distinctions between God and Godhead, intellect, creation, and the *in quantum* relation by which an identity holds according to a determinate respect.

scenes.name: Psychology — Crowd, Complex, Psychoid, and Provisional Self
scenes.character: A stream of the Logos in time; stations mark its movement.

steps.text: From the crowd to the mass State
The divided psyche and the work of individuation
Psyche and matter meet at the psychoid
Structures of consciousness and historical time

text.title: Psychology — Crowd, Complex, Psychoid, and Provisional Self
text.italic: Movements 05-s01-p4-gebser-diaphaneity 12-s0-p5-objective-internality 20-s2-p1-dia-ballein 21-s2-p2-sym-ballein +12 more · domain psychology

text.body: Le Bon's *The Crowd* gives the source pool's earliest sustained account of a psychological crowd. His narrow structural point survives the racial and evolutionary doctrines that surround it: under shared influence, a collectivity can make its participants feel, think, and act differently from their isolated condition, and this formation can occur without physical assembly. The crowd is a combination that produces new characteristics.

scenes.name: Technology, Politics, and Institutions — From Mass Formation to Planetary Technē
scenes.character: A stream of the Logos in time; stations mark its movement.

steps.text: Technē returns to its mythic and planetary depth

text.title: Technology, Politics, and Institutions — From Mass Formation to Planetary Technē
text.italic: Movements 01-s01-p0-question-before-mechanism 12-s0-p5-objective-internality 20-s2-p1-dia-ballein 21-s2-p2-sym-ballein +14 more · domain technology-politics-institutions

text.body: Le Bon's 1895 crowd psychology already allows a nation to become a psychological crowd under shared influences without physical assembly. Broadcast and network media later provide the channels for this distributed formation. Jung's *The Undiscovered Self* adds the relation between statistical abstraction, mass identity, collectivised responsibility, and a State that appears as a quasi-personality.

The unconscious becomes a scientific psychic fact

text.body: Kaplan supplies the narrative movement from Babylonian separator through astronomical absence-marker, Indian arithmetic, Arabic transmission, European reception, set-theoretic construction, and the boundary pair `0/1`, `1/0`. The source's force lies in the changing office of the sign.

roz-etymologies.name: Return of Zero — Etymology whole-fields
roz-etymologies.description: Six etymology wholes as six-operation fields: centre, envelope, generated relations; evidence registers distinguished.

scenes.name: Encounter / Region / Name / Count / Countenance / Account
scenes.character: A whole-field: six operations generated around one centre, returns kept open.

text.title: Encounter / Region / Name / Count / Countenance / Account
text.italic: Argued from · evidence registers: descent, attested sense, operational homology, poetic re-entry kept distinct

text.body: The priority is operative, not a claim that people first met without language and only later invented it. An inherited name can make the meeting possible. Its use nevertheless takes place within a relation which can exceed and revise that use. Taylor's encounter synthesis grounds the whole-field proposition: the with-relation is prior to treating its opposed terms as independently complete.

scenes.name: Whole Field — Arbitration / Hybris / Regard / Anamnesis
scenes.character: A whole-field: six operations generated around one centre, returns kept open.

text.title: Whole Field — Arbitration / Hybris / Regard / Anamnesis
text.italic: field E2 · Argued authorial relational construction; source-specific semantic, historical and comparative branches distinguished. · evidence registers: descent, attested sense, operational homology, poetic re-entry kept distinct

text.body: The field does not claim that *arbitration*, *hybris*, *regard* and *anamnesis* descend from one root. Historical derivation and attested senses belong to registers 1 Philological descent and 2 Attested semantic field and must be warranted term by term in the historical/source branch.
